items.title: EASL-EASD-EASO Guidance for the Use of Resmetirom and Semaglutide as MASH-Targeted Therapy.
items.abstract: Adults with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and steatohepatitis (MASH) are at risk for cardiometabolic complications and major adverse liver-related outcomes (MALO), including cirrhosis, cancer, and liver transplantation. Non-invasive tests (NIT) for hepatic fibrosis, including vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE), magnetic resonance elastography (MRE), or enhanced liver fibrosis (ELF) score, can replace liver biopsy to identify high risk for MALO (e.g. VCTE 10-20 kPa, MRE 3.1-5.0 kPa, or ELF 9.8-11.3), in which pharmacotherapy may be considered. Following approval by regulatory agencies, this joint EASL-EASD-EASO guidance provides updated recommendations for the use of resmetirom (80mg/100mg po) and semaglutide (2.4 mg sc weekly) in MASH, covering treatment candidate selection, treatment initiation, monitoring, and discontinuation. Pharmacotherapy is recommended for adults with non-cirrhotic MASH and fibrosis stages 2-3 (based on NITs or biopsy), alongside structured lifestyle intervention and optimized comorbidity management. Therapy selection should be individualized according to preferences, potential risks, and cardio-renal-metabolic profile, including presence of obesity, type 2 diabetes (T2D), cardiovascular, and chronic kidney disease. Semaglutide, a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA), may be preferred in adults with obesity or T2D as well as with established cardiovascular (CV) disease or high CV risk because of its cardiometabolic benefits, whereas resmetirom may be prioritized in individuals without obesity or those already receiving or intolerant to GLP-1RAs. Additional recommendations include structured safety and efficacy monitoring such as nutritional and sarcopenia assessment during semaglutide or use of fibrosis NITs for longitudinal response criteria. Ongoing studies are evaluating long-term effectiveness of both agents to reduce MALO. In adults with MASH cirrhosis, resmetirom or semaglutide appear safe but should not be used as MASH-targeted treatment, until further data establish liver-related benefits.
items.summary_ja: EASL-EASD-EASOが共同で発表した、MASH（メタボリック機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎）を対象としたresmetirom（80mg/100mg 経口）とsemaglutide（2.4mg 週1回皮下注射）の使用に関するガイダンス。治療対象者の選定、治療開始、モニタリング、中止基準をカバーし、非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化ステージ2-3の成人に対して、構造化された生活習慣介入および合併症管理と併せて薬物療法を推奨する。治療選択は肥満、2型糖尿病、心血管疾患、慢性腎臓病の有無など個々の心・腎・代謝プロファイルに基づき個別化すべきとされている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化ステージ2-3の成人では、resmetiromまたはsemaglutideによる薬物療法が推奨される。semaglutideは肥満・2型糖尿病・心血管疾患を有する患者に、resmetiromは肥満を有しない患者やGLP-1RA不耐容・使用中の患者に優先的に考慮される。MASH肝硬変では安全性は示唆されるが、肝関連の利益が確立されるまでMASH標的治療としては使用すべきでない。
items.why_matters_ja: MASLD/MASHを有する成人は心血管代謝合併症や重大な肝関連アウトカム（MALO：肝硬変、肝がん、肝移植）のリスクが高く、規制当局の承認後に初めてこれら2剤の使用に関する統合的な臨床ガイダンスが提示されたことで、実臨床における治療意思決定の根拠となる。
items.study_type_ja: プラクティスガイドライン（EASL-EASD-EASO共同ガイダンス）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に明示的な臨床試験のエンドポイント定義は記載されていない。MALO（肝硬変、肝がん、肝移植）が主要な肝関連アウトカムとして言及され、線維化NIT（VCTE、MRE、ELF）による縦断的応答評価が推奨事項として述べられている。

items.title: Efficacy of Subcutaneous Semaglutide Dose Escalation in Reducing Insulin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a chronic disease that affects nearly 25% of patients in the US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health care system. Semaglutide 2 mg has been found to significantly improve hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) when compared with semaglutide 1 mg in patients who are not taking insulin. The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect subcutaneous semaglutide dose escalation has on total daily insulin dose in patients with T2DM.
METHODS: This retrospective, single-center chart review study was conducted at the VA Sioux Falls Health Care System. The primary endpoint was change in daily insulin dose from baseline to semaglutide dose increase after receiving semaglutide 2 mg for ≥ 3 months. Baseline was defined as initiation of semaglutide 0.5 mg. Secondary endpoints included changes in daily bolus or basal insulin doses, HbA1c level, and number of hypoglycemic events reported.
RESULTS: Sixty-two patients were included. Daily insulin dose changed -5.6% (95% CI, 2.2-14.0; P = .008) from baseline to 1-mg dose initiation, -22.2% (95% CI, 22.0-35.1; P < .001) at 2-mg dose initiation, and -36.9% (95% CI, 37.4-56.5; P < .001) after ≥ 3 months at the 2-mg dose. Mean HbA1c level decreased from 7.7% at baseline to 7.1% at 2-mg dose initiation (95% CI, 0.3-0.8; P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS: There were statistically significant reductions in total daily insulin dose when subcutaneous semaglutide was initiated and further reduction with each semaglutide dose increase. These results support the current practice of prescribing semaglutide to treat T2DM and suggest that when the dose is increased to 2 mg, patients may experience reductions in total daily insulin dose and HbA1c levels.
items.journal: Federal practitioner : for the health care professionals of the VA, DoD, and PHS
items.authors: Halver Alisha, Wiksen John, Larson Aaron, Wegner Amber
items.summary_ja: VA Sioux Falls Health Care Systemにおいて実施された後ろ向き単一施設カルテレビュー研究。2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者における皮下注射セマグルチドの増量（0.5 mg→1 mg→2 mg）が総日量インスリン用量に与える影響を調査した。主要エンドポイントは、セマグルチド2 mgを3か月以上使用後のインスリン日量の変化（ベースラインはセマグルチド0.5 mg開始時）であり、二次エンドポイントはボルス/ベースアルインスリン日量の変化、HbA1c値、低血糖事象の報告数であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 皮下注射セマグルチドの増量に伴い、総日量インスリン用量が統計的に有意に減少した（1 mg開始時 -5.6%、2 mg開始時 -22.2%、2 mg 3か月以上継続時 -36.9%）。また、HbA1cはベースライン7.7%から2 mg開始時7.1%へ低下した。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチドの2 mgへの増量により総日量インスリン用量およびHbA1c値の低下が期待できることを示し、T2DMに対するセマグルチド処方の現行プラクティスを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き単一施設カルテレビュー研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：セマグルチド2 mgを3か月以上使用後のインスリン日量の変化（ベースライン＝セマグルチド0.5 mg開始時）。二次エンドポイント：ボルス/ベースアルインスリン日量の変化、HbA1c値、低血糖事象の報告数。

items.title: Empagliflozin Improves Angina and Endothelial Dysfunction Indices in Angina and No Obstructive Coronary Arteries (ANOCA).
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Treatments targeting endothelial dysfunction in patients with angina and no obstructive coronary arteries (ANOCA) and coronary microvascular and vasomotor dysfunction (CMVD) are lacking. We evaluated the effects of SGLT2i (sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibition) on angina, inflammatory and oxidative stress biomarkers, and endothelial dysfunction indices using a serum-induced in vitro model in ANOCA patients with CMVD. We conducted an open-label pilot trial of 11 ANOCA participants with CMVD diagnosed by invasive coronary function testing receiving empagliflozin (10 mg daily) for 90 days.
METHODS: Angina (Seattle Angina Questionnaire), circulating inflammatory and oxidative stress biomarkers, and endothelial microvesicles (eEVs) were assessed from baseline to 45 and 90 days, and from 90 days to posttreatment discontinuation in a subset (N=5). A serum-induced in vitro model of human coronary artery endothelial cells was used to evaluate endothelial cell apoptosis, viability, eEV release, VCAM-1 (vascular cell adhesion molecule-1) expression, and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species. Stored serum from ANOCA patients without CMVD (controls, N=6) was compared with baseline samples.
RESULTS: All trial participants had coronary endothelial dysfunction, with concomitant coronary microvascular dysfunction (55%), coronary spasm (54%), and microvascular spasm (18%). Empagliflozin significantly improved Seattle Angina Questionnaire summary scores by 14.0 (4.2-23.9) points at 90 days (P<0.001). Compared with baseline, empagliflozin significantly reduced inflammatory cytokines, oxidative stress biomarkers, and inflammatory eEVs while increasing anti-inflammatory cytokines, antioxidants, and repair eEVs at 45 and 90 days; these effects rebounded after treatment discontinuation. Similarly, serum collected during empagliflozin treatment significantly reduced endothelial cell apoptosis, eEV release, VCAM-1 expression, and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species in vitro, with reversal of these effects at posttreatment discontinuation.
CONCLUSIONS: In ANOCA participants with invasive coronary function testing confirmed CMVD, SGLT2i therapy produced clinically meaningful anti-anginal effects and reversed multiple indices of endothelial dysfunction, with rebound after treatment discontinuation. These findings support further evaluation in larger clinical trials.
items.authors: Tapp Danielle N, Kaur Sukhleen, Toleva Olga, Tipler Paxson, Ashokprabhu Namrita, Acharya Pooja, Schmidt Christian W, Korbee Leslie
items.summary_ja: 侵襲的冠動脈機能検査で冠微小血管機能障害（CMVD）が確認されたANOCA患者11名を対象に、エンパグリフロジン10 mg/日を90日間投与するオープンラベル・パイロット試験を行った。Seattle Angina Questionnaire（SAQ）、循環性炎症・酸化ストレスバイオマーカー、内皮マイクロベシクル（eEV）をベースラインから45日・90日、および治療中止後（サブセットN=5）まで評価した。また、ANOCA患者（CMVDなし、対照N=6）の血清を用いたin vitroモデルで、冠動脈内皮細胞のアポトーシス、生存率、eEV放出、VCAM-1発現、ミトコンドリア活性酸素種を評価した。結果として、SAQサマリースコアは90日時点で14.0（4.2–23.9）ポイント有意に改善（P<0.001）し、炎症性サイトカイン・酸化ストレスバイオマーカー・炎症性eEVは減少、抗炎症性サイトカイン・抗酸化物質・修復性eEVは増加した。in vitroでも内皮細胞アポトーシス、eEV放出、VCAM-1発現、ミトコンドリア活性酸素種が有意に減少した。これらの効果は治療中止後に反跳した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ANOCAでCMVDを有する患者において、SGLT2阻害薬（エンパグリフロジン）は臨床的に有意な抗狭心症効果を示し、複数の内皮機能障害指標を改善したが、治療中止後に反跳が認められた。
items.why_matters_ja: ANOCAおよびCMVD患者における内皮機能障害を標的とする治療法は不足している。本試験はSGLT2阻害薬がANOCA/CMVD患者の狭心症および内皮機能障害に有効である可能性を示し、より大規模な臨床試験の必要性を支持する。
items.study_type_ja: オープンラベル・パイロット試験
items.endpoints_ja: Seattle Angina Questionnaire（SAQ）サマリースコア、循環性炎症性サイトカイン、酸化ストレスバイオマーカー、内皮マイクロベシクル（eEV）、in vitroでの冠動脈内皮細胞アポトーシス・生存率・eEV放出・VCAM-1発現・ミトコンドリア活性酸素種
items.endpoint_results_ja: SAQサマリースコア：90日時点で14.0（4.2–23.9）ポイント改善（P<0.001）。その他のバイオマーカーおよびin vitro指標については、有意な変化が記述されているが、具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし。
items.sample_size_ja: 主要試験：ANOCAでCMVDを有する患者11名。治療中止後評価サブセット：N=5。対照（ANOCAでCMVDなし）：N=6

items.title: Weight gain, adipose tissue remodeling and cardiometabolic disease in people with HIV.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Weight gain and associated adipose tissue remodeling have been partly linked to HIV infection and to some current antiretroviral therapy (ART) regimens in ART-naive and ART-controlled people with HIV (PWH). This review addresses recent findings on adipose tissue distribution and remodeling in PWH, receiving dolutegravir, bictegravir and/or tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), highlighting how visceral adiposity contributes to cardiometabolic comorbidities.
RECENT FINDINGS: Preclinical models exposed to dolutegravir, bictegravir, tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) and/or TAF demonstrate alterations in adipose tissue, including mitochondrial dysfunction, fibrosis, inhibited beiging, and insulin resistance. Transcriptomic studies of abdominal subcutaneous fat from ART-controlled PWH further revealed elevated inflammation, fibrosis and insulin resistance. Increased visceral adiposity raises the risk of cardiometabolic disorders such as insulin resistance and diabetes, metabolic-dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and cardiovascular diseases. Reversing weight gain linked to ART, by switching regimens or adding antiobesity medications like the GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide, has shown potential in reducing adipose tissue remodeling, visceral adiposity and cardiometabolic risk factors.
SUMMARY: Weight gain and increased visceral adiposity partly driven by some ARTs are associated with higher cardiometabolic risk. HIV and ART can either activate or suppress the fat beiging/browning phenotype. Reversing weight gain and visceral adiposity in at-risk PWH is a critical clinical goal.
items.journal: Current opinion in HIV and AIDS
items.authors: Gorwood Jennifer, Capeau Jacqueline, Béréziat Véronique, Lagathu Claire
items.summary_ja: HIV感染者（PWH）における体重増加と脂肪組織のリモデリングは、HIV感染自体および一部の現在の抗レトロウイルス療法（ART）レジメンと部分的に関連している。本レビューは、ドゥルテグラビル、ビクテグラビル、テノフォビルアラフェナミド（TAF）を投与されているPWHにおける脂肪組織の分布とリモデリングに関する最近の知見を整理し、内臓脂肪蓄積が心代謝合併症にどのように寄与するかを強調している。前臨床モデルでは、ドゥルテグラビル、ビクテグラビル、TDF、TAFに曝露された際にミトコンドリア機能障害、線維化、ベージング抑制、インスリン抵抗性が示された。ART管理下PWHの腹部皮下脂肪の転写体解析では、炎症、線維化、インスリン抵抗性の亢進が明らかになった。ART関連の体重増加をレジメン変更やGLP-1受容体作動薬（セマグルチド）の追加により逆転させることが、脂肪組織リモデリング、内臓脂肪蓄積、心代謝リスク因子の低減に有効である可能性が示されている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 一部のARTに起因する体重増加と内臓脂肪蓄積の増加は、心代謝リスクの上昇と関連しており、リスクのあるPWHにおける体重増加と内臓脂肪蓄積の逆転は重要な臨床目標である。
items.why_matters_ja: HIV感染者の寿命が延びる中で、心代謝疾患（インスリン抵抗性・糖尿病、代謝機能障害関連脂肪性肝疾患、心血管疾患）が主要な死因となりつつある。ARTレジメン選択や体重管理介入が心代謝リスク低減に寄与する可能性は、PWHの長期管理において臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（総説）
items.endpoints_ja: 脂肪組織リモデリング（ミトコンドリア機能障害、線維化、ベージング抑制、インスリン抵抗性）、内臓脂肪蓄積、心代謝リスク因子（インスリン抵抗性、糖尿病、代謝機能障害関連脂肪性肝疾患、心血管疾患）

items.title: Bridging the gap in early cardio-renal risk prevention in type 2 diabetes: evidence, guidelines, and real-world insights from the PRECARE NO LiMITS initiative.
items.abstract: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) is associated with a substantial burden of cardiovascular and renal complications. Although current evidence supports early implementation of organ-protective strategies, therapeutic inertia and uncertainty regarding guideline implementation may delay treatment intensification. The goal of this review is to discuss the rationale for early cardiorenal protection in T2D and to explore real-world perspectives on the use of SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 receptor agonists through insights from the PRECARE NO LiMITS initiative. This narrative review integrates current evidence with exploratory findings from the PRECARE NO LiMITS project, a multicentre educational initiative involving diabetologists from ten diabetes centres in Lombardy, Italy. The initiative included two descriptive clinician survey rounds, conducted at baseline (T0) and after six months (T1), together with moderated expert discussions. At T1, a higher proportion of respondents reported considering SGLT2 inhibitor initiation in a greater proportion of patients with early cardiorenal risk markers, including albuminuria and mildly reduced eGFR, even in the absence of established cardiovascular or renal disease. Survey responses also suggested greater consideration of risk-based treatment strategies extending beyond glycaemic control alone. Persistent perceived barriers included reliance on HbA1c as a primary driver of treatment intensification, uncertainty regarding the timing and implementation of organ-protective therapies, and concerns related to treatment complexity and access. Given the descriptive nature of the survey, differences between T0 and T1 should be interpreted as exploratory. Overall, these exploratory observations, considered alongside current evidence and guideline recommendations, highlight the potential value of a proactive approach to T2D management focused on early identification of cardiorenal risk and appropriate consideration of organ-protective therapies. Educational initiatives, multidisciplinary collaboration, and improved translation of guideline recommendations into routine clinical practice may help address therapeutic inertia and facilitate timely, individualised treatment decisions.
items.authors: Bucciarelli Loredana, Lunati Maria Elena, Berra Cesare, Cerutti Nadia, Conti Antonio, Ghelardi Renata, Girelli Angela, Morpurgo Paola
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病における早期心腎保護の根拠と、SGLT2阻害薬およびGLP-1受容体作動薬の実際の使用に関するPRECARE NO LiMITSイニシアチブからの洞察を統合した叙述的レビュー。ロンバルディア州10の糖尿病センターの糖尿病専門医を対象に、ベースライン（T0）と6ヶ月後（T1）の2回の記述的医師調査およびモデレートされた専門家討論を実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 教育介入後（T1）には、アルブミン尿や軽度低下したeGFRなどの早期心腎リスクマーカーを有する患者に対するSGLT2阻害薬開始の検討率の上昇が観察されたが、HbA1c依存の治療強化判断、臓器保護療法のタイミングに関する不確実性、治療の複雑性やアクセスへの懸念などの障壁は残存した。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病における治療慣性（therapeutic inertia）が臓器保護療法の早期導入を遅らせている現状に対し、ガイドラインの臨床実践への転換を促進する教育介入や多職種連携の価値を示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（PRECARE NO LiMITSプロジェクトの記述的調査結果を含む）
items.endpoints_ja: 早期心腎リスクマーカー（アルブミン尿、軽度低下したeGFR）を有する患者に対するSGLT2阻害薬開始の検討率、リスクベースの治療戦略の検討、治療強化の障壁
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値は記載されていない。T1においてT0と比較してSGLT2阻害薬開始の検討率の上昇が定性的に報告されているのみ。

items.title: Comparative hepatic effectiveness of empagliflozin vs dapagliflozin among individuals with type 2 diabetes and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.
items.abstract:
AIMS/HYPOTHESIS: While both empagliflozin and dapagliflozin are known to improve hepatic steatosis and liver enzyme levels, robust phase 3 trial evidence for improving steatohepatitis and fibrosis is currently exclusive to dapagliflozin. Therefore, a head-to-head comparison between two agents is warranted, to compare the hepatic outcomes between empagliflozin and dapagliflozin in individuals with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD).
METHODS: Using nationwide Korean claims data, we constructed a new-user cohort of adults with MASLD, defined as having type 2 diabetes and a fatty liver index (FLI) ≥60, who initiated empagliflozin or dapagliflozin between May 2016 and December 2023. Outcomes of interest were FLI-defined MASLD regression (achieving FLI <30) and decompensated hepatic events (ascites, variceal bleeding, hepatic failure, liver transplantation). After 1:1 propensity score matching, HRs and 95% CIs were estimated using Cox models.
RESULTS: Among 265,098 new users of empagliflozin and dapagliflozin, 101,487 pairs were 1:1 propensity score-matched (mean age 54.3 years; male 71.3%). Compared with dapagliflozin, empagliflozin was associated with a marginally higher likelihood of FLI-defined MASLD regression (HR 1.06; 95% CI 1.00, 1.11). The risk of decompensated hepatic events was comparable (HR 0.99; 95% CI 0.94, 1.03). Dose-stratified analyses yielded consistent findings in both FLI-defined MASLD regression (low-dose: HR 1.19; 95% CI 0.77, 1.83; high-dose: 1.14; 1.01, 1.28) and decompensated hepatic events (low-dose: 0.95; 0.74, 1.23; high-dose: 1.04; 0.93, 1.15).
CONCLUSIONS/INTERPRETATION: Among individuals with MASLD, no significant differences were observed between empagliflozin and dapagliflozin in the risk of decompensated hepatic events.
items.authors: Kim Suyeon, Ko Hwa Yeon, Hong Bin, Kim Ju Hwan, Bea Sungho, Bae Jae Hyun, Cho Young Min, Chang Yoosoo
items.summary_ja: 韓国全国保険請求データを用いた新使用者コホート研究であり、MASLD（2型糖尿病かつFLI≥60）を有する成人において、2016年5月から2023年12月にエンパグリフロジンまたはダパグリフロジンを開始した患者を対象に、1:1プロパティスコアマッチング後、Coxモデルで肝臓アウトカムを比較した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MASLDを有する患者において、エンパグリフロジンとダパグリフロジン間で肝不全イベントのリスクに有意な差は認められなかった（HR 0.99; 95% CI 0.94, 1.03）。FLI定義MASLD改善ではエンパグリフロジンがわずかに高い可能性を示したが、差は限定的であった（HR 1.06; 95% CI 1.00, 1.11）。
items.why_matters_ja: 肝脂肪肝炎や線維化の改善に対する確実な第III相試験のエビデンスは現在ダパグリフロジンにのみ存在するため、両薬剤の肝臓アウトカムに関するヘッドトゥヘッド比較は臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 全国保険請求データを用いた観察的コホート研究（新使用者デザイン、1:1プロパティスコアマッチング）
items.endpoints_ja: FLI定義MASLD改善（FLI<30の達成）、肝不全イベント（腹水、食道静脈瘤出血、肝不全、肝移植）
items.sample_size_ja: エンパグリフロジンとダパグリフロジンの新使用者合計265,098例。1:1プロパティスコアマッチング後101,487対（平均年齢54.3歳、男性71.3%）。

items.title: Semaglutide in type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease in Australia: practical clinical considerations from a multidisciplinary panel.
items.abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and cardiovascular disease (CVD) are major causes of morbidity and mortality in people with type 2 diabetes (T2D). Contemporary CKD guidelines increasingly support incorporation of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) as an additional pillar of cardiorenal therapy alongside renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) blockade, sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and finerenone. Semaglutide is the first GLP-1RA with kidney-outcome data from a dedicated trial in T2D-CKD: the Evaluate Renal Function with Semaglutide Once Weekly (FLOW) study. In FLOW, once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide 1 mg reduced major kidney disease events by 24%, major adverse cardiovascular events by 18% and all-cause mortality by 20% versus placebo on a background of guideline-directed therapy. Here a multidisciplinary expert panel summarises Australian Therapeutic Goods Administration indications and Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme restrictions, highlights common access barriers and outlines approaches to shared care between primary and tertiary services for use of GLP-1RAs. Guidance is also provided on treatment sequencing of GLP-1RA alongside RAAS blockade, SGLT2i and finerenone. Evidence from key GLP-1RA trials, in addition to FLOW, is reviewed and translated into practical, implementable prescribing strategies for Australian clinicians. The panel also identified priority patient groups for GLP-1RA therapy, including those with residual albuminuria, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, established CVD, obesity and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples at high cardiorenal risk. Remaining evidence gaps, particularly for non-diabetic CKD, advanced CKD, dialysis and transplant populations and equity of access, are identified as priorities for future research and policy.
items.authors: Pedagogos Eugenia, Chen Roger, Nelson Adam, Badve Sunil, Rasalam Roy, MacIsaac Richard
items.summary_ja: オーストラリアの多職種専門家パネルが、2型糖尿病（T2D）を伴う慢性腎臓病（CKD）患者におけるセマグルチドの実践的な臨床的考慮事項をまとめたレビューである。FLOW試験の結果（週1回皮下投与セマグルチド1 mgが主要腎疾患イベントを24%、主要心血管イベントを18%、全死因死亡率を20%減少）を基に、オーストラリアのTGA適応・PBS制限、アクセス障壁、一次医療と三次医療の共同管理、RAAS阻害薬・SGLT2阻害薬・フィネロノンとの治療順序、優先患者群（残存アルブミン尿、HFpEF、確立したCVD、肥満、高心腎リスクの先住民）を提示し、非糖尿病CKD・高度CKD・透析・移植患者およびアクセスの公平性に関するエビデンスギャップを将来の優先課題として特定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドはT2D-CKDにおいて専用試験（FLOW）で腎アウトカムデータを有する初のGLP-1RAであり、オーストラリアの臨床医向けに実践的な処方戦略が提示された。
items.why_matters_ja: CKDとCVDはT2D患者の主要な有病率・死亡率の原因であり、GLP-1RAをRAAS阻害・SGLT2阻害・フィネロノンと並ぶ心腎治療の柱として位置づける実践的なガイドラインが提供されることで、臨床現場での適切な治療選択とアクセス改善に寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（多職種専門家パネルによる実践的レビュー）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要腎疾患イベント、主要心血管イベント（MACE）、全死因死亡率（FLOW試験）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要腎疾患イベント：プラセボ比で24%減少、主要心血管イベント：プラセボ比で18%減少、全死因死亡率：プラセボ比で20%減少

items.title: Finerenone versus spironolactone in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction: a real-world study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Finerenone has shown benefit in chronic kidney disease, type 2 diabetes, and heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction (HFmrEF/HFpEF), but head-to-head data against spironolactone are limited. We compared 12-month effectiveness and safety after finerenone versus spironolactone initiation in heart failure with left ventricular ejection fraction ≥40%.
METHODS AND RESULTS: We conducted a retrospective active-comparator, new-user cohort study using the TriNetX Network from 9 July 2021 to 31 March 2025. Adults of both sexes with HFmrEF/HFpEF initiating finerenone or spironolactone were matched 1:1 by propensity score. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality or heart failure exacerbation. Secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality, heart failure exacerbation, all-cause hospitalisation, and acute myocardial infarction; safety outcomes were hyperkalaemia and acute kidney injury. After matching, 1417 patients were included in each group. Finerenone initiation was associated with lower risk of the primary outcome (32.3% vs. 41.7%; adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 0.72, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.64-0.82; P < 0.001). Lower risks were also observed for all-cause mortality (aHR 0.67, 95% CI 0.51-0.87), heart failure exacerbation (aHR 0.73, 95% CI 0.64-0.83), and all-cause hospitalisation (aHR 0.83, 95% CI 0.76-0.91), but not acute myocardial infarction. Hyperkalaemia was less frequent with finerenone (17.9% vs. 22.8%; risk ratio 0.79, 95% CI 0.68-0.91); acute kidney injury showed only a borderline difference.
CONCLUSIONS: Finerenone initiation was associated with lower 12-month clinical event and hyperkalaemia risks than spironolactone initiation. These observational associations should be considered hypothesis-generating and require confirmation in randomised head-to-head trials.
items.authors: Ha Pham Trong Khang, Chao Chieh-Ju, Hung Chung-Lieh, Chang Hung-Yu, Chen Chih-Wei, Lin Yi-Cheng, Huang Chun-Yao, Shao Yu-Hsuan
items.summary_ja: TriNetXネットワークを用いた後方視的アクティブコンパレーター・ニューユーザーコホート研究。LVEF≥40%のHFmrEF/HFpEF患者において、フィネレノンとスピロノラクトンの12ヶ月間の有効性及び安全性を比較した。プロパティスコアにより1:1マッチングを行い、各群1417例を解析した。主要エンドポイントは全死因死亡または心不全増悪であり、フィネレノン群で有意に低リスクであった（32.3% vs 41.7%; aHR 0.72, 95% CI 0.64-0.82; P<0.001）。全死因死亡、心不全増悪、全死因入院でも低リスクが示された。高カリウム血症はフィネレノン群で少なかった（17.9% vs 22.8%）。著者は本結果は仮説生成性であり、ランダム化比較試験での確認が必要と結論している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: HFmrEF/HFpEF患者において、フィネレノンの開始はスピロノラクトンの開始と比較して12ヶ月間の臨床イベントリスクおよび高カリウム血症リスクが低いとの観察的関連が示されたが、本結果は仮説生成性であり、ランダム化比較試験での確認を要する。
items.why_matters_ja: フィネレノンとスピロノラクトンの頭突き比較データは限られており、本実世界研究はHFmrEF/HFpEFにおける両薬剤の比較有効性及び安全性に関する貴重なエビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的アクティブコンパレーター・ニューユーザーコホート研究（実世界研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：全死因死亡または心不全増悪。二次エンドポイント：全死因死亡、心不全増悪、全死因入院、急性心筋梗塞。安全性エンドポイント：高カリウム血症、急性腎障害。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要エンドポイント（全死因死亡または心不全増悪）：32.3% vs 41.7%; aHR 0.72, 95% CI 0.64-0.82; P<0.001。全死因死亡：aHR 0.67, 95% CI 0.51-0.87。心不全増悪：aHR 0.73, 95% CI 0.64-0.83。全死因入院：aHR 0.83, 95% CI 0.76-0.91。急性心筋梗塞：有意差なし（数値記載なし）。高カリウム血症：17.9% vs 22.8%; risk ratio 0.79, 95% CI 0.68-0.91。急性腎障害：境界的な差（数値記載なし）。

items.title: Real-world effectiveness and safety of low-dose tirzepatide in Japanese people with type 2 diabetes: a multicenter, retrospective, single-arm, observational study-East Shizuoka Tirzepatide (ESTATE) study.
items.abstract: The glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP)/glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist tirzepatide is available clinically. Although real-world studies of tirzepatide in Japanese people with type 2 diabetes (T2D) have been reported, data regarding low-dose tirzepatide and patient-reported outcomes in routine clinical practice remain limited. In this multicenter retrospective observational study, we evaluated changes in glycemic control, body mass index (BMI), metabolic parameters, patient-reported outcomes, and adverse events after initiation of low-dose tirzepatide in Japanese people with T2D. Eighty-eight subjects with T2D treated with an average dose of tirzepatide of 4.5 ± 1.0 mg/week for 24 weeks were retrospectively analyzed. The primary outcomes were changes in glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) and BMI from baseline to 24 weeks. HbA1c levels and BMI decreased over 24 weeks after initiation of low-dose tirzepatide (HbA1c, -1.5%; BMI, -1.5 kg/m2; both p < 0.001). Additionally, serum albumin was increased, and alanine transaminase and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol were decreased significantly. In multivariable regression analysis, higher baseline HbA1c was associated with greater HbA1c reduction. In exploratory cross-sectional analyses, post-treatment Diabetes Treatment Satisfaction Questionnaire (DTSQ) scores were associated with higher baseline HbA1c, and Kanden Institute Stigma Scale (KISS) scores were associated with higher baseline BMI. Major adverse events linked with tirzepatide were gastrointestinal symptoms. In this multicenter retrospective single-arm observational study, HbA1c and BMI decreased over 24 weeks after low-dose tirzepatide initiation in Japanese people with T2D. These findings suggest that low-dose tirzepatide may be a useful treatment option in selected patients in routine clinical practice, although causal inference is limited by the observational design and lack of a control group.Trial Registration: National University Hospital Medical Information Network (UMIN Clinical Trial Registry, UMIN000053671; approval date: March 1, 2024).
items.authors: Iwamoto Tatsuya, Yamasaki Nozomu, Nojiri Shuko, Urasaki Wataru, Aso Katsumi, Komatsu Katsutoshi, Enosawa Naoko, Kanzaki Marie
items.summary_ja: 本多施設後ろ向き単群観察研究（ESTATE研究）では、日本人2型糖尿病患者88名を対象に、低用量tirzepatide（平均4.5±1.0 mg/週、24週間）開始後の血糖コントロール、BMI、代謝パラメータ、患者報告アウトカム、有害事象の変化を評価した。主要アウトカムはベースラインから24週までのHbA1cおよびBMIの変化であり、両者ともに有意に低下した（HbA1c -1.5%、BMI -1.5 kg/m²、いずれもp<0.001）。また、血清アルブミンは増加し、ALTおよびLDL-Cは有意に低下した。多変量回帰分析では、ベースラインHbA1cが高いほどHbA1c低下幅が大きいことが示された。探索的横断分析では、治療後DTSQスコアはベースラインHbA1cと、KISSスコアはベースラインBMIと関連した。主な有害事象は消化管症状であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 日本人2型糖尿病患者において、低用量tirzepatide（平均4.5 mg/週）の24週間投与によりHbA1cおよびBMIが有意に低下し、通常の臨床実践において選択された患者に有用な治療選択肢となり得るが、観察研究デザインのため因果推論には限界がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 低用量tirzepatideおよび通常の臨床実践における患者報告アウトカムに関するデータは限られており、本研究は日本人2型糖尿病患者における低用量tirzepatideの実臨床での有効性と安全性に関する貴重なエビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 多施設、後ろ向き、単群、観察研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：ベースラインから24週までのHbA1cの変化、ベースラインから24週までのBMIの変化。副次/探索的評価：代謝パラメータ（血清アルブミン、ALT、LDL-C）、患者報告アウトカム（DTSQスコア、KISSスコア）、有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: HbA1c：-1.5%（p<0.001）、BMI：-1.5 kg/m²（p<0.001）、血清アルブミン：増加（有意）、ALT：低下（有意）、LDL-C：低下（有意）、主な有害事象：消化管症状

items.title: Efficacy and Safety of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors for Heart Failure in Children and Adolescents: A Single-Arm and Pairwise Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis with GRADE Assessment of the Evidence.
items.abstract: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are a cornerstone of adult heart failure (HF) therapy and are increasingly prescribed off-label to children, yet pediatric outcomes have never been pooled. We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science to 14 August 2026 for studies of any SGLT2 inhibitor in children or adolescents with HF and performed a single-arm meta-analysis of all exposed patients and a pairwise meta-analysis of the comparative studies with random-effects models. Nine studies contributed 599 exposed patients and 97 controls. Pooled rates were 3.8% (95% confidence interval [CI] 1.6-8.4) for mortality, 8.5% (6.2-11.5) for transplantation, 11.2% (8.2-15.1) for worsening HF, 0.2% (0.03-1.6) for ketoacidosis, 4.5% (1.2-14.9) for acute kidney injury, 3.7% (1.1-11.7) for urinary tract infection, and 4.1% (1.4-11.2) for discontinuation because of an adverse event. After initiation, left ventricular ejection fraction rose by 7.7 percentage points (3.6-11.8) and natriuretic peptide fell by 0.42 standard deviations (0.34-0.49). In the comparative synthesis (63 exposed, 97 unexposed), risk ratios were 0.80 (0.11-6.07) for mortality and 0.21 (0.03-1.68) for worsening HF; ejection fraction improved 3.34 percentage points more with SGLT2 inhibitors (0.22-6.46) whereas natriuretic peptide did not differ (standardized mean difference -0.09, -0.50 to 0.33).
items.authors: Aldossary Leen Adel, Alanazi Raghad Mamdouh, Almutairi Rana Motlk, Mugibel Tayba Abdulrahman, Ghanam Karen Deaa, Ben-Obaidellah Robaiya Awadh Robaiya, Mohammed Khloud Awadh, Alharbi Asrar Abdulkarim
items.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の心不全におけるSGLT2阻害薬の有効性と安全性を評価した単一アームおよびペアワイズ系統レビュー・メタ解析。PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Web of Scienceを2026年8月14日までに検索し、9研究から599例の曝露患者と97例の対照を抽出。ランダム効果モデルで単一アームメタ解析とペアワイズメタ解析を実施し、GRADE評価を行った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 小児心不全におけるSGLT2阻害薬の単一アームメタ解析では、死亡率3.8%、移植率8.5%、心不全悪化率11.2%、ケトアシドーシス0.2%と報告され、LVEFは7.7ポイント上昇、ナトリウム利尿ペプチドは0.42SD低下した。比較解析では心不全悪化のリスク比0.21（95%CI 0.03-1.68）と有意な低下傾向が示された。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は成人心不全治療の基盤であり、小児にも増してoff-labelで処方されているが、小児のアウトカムがこれまでにプーリングされたことがなかった。本メタ解析は初めて小児・思春期の心不全におけるSGLT2阻害薬のアウトカムを統合したものである。
items.study_type_ja: 単一アームおよびペアワイズ系統レビュー・メタ解析（GRADE評価付き）
items.endpoints_ja: 死亡率、移植率、心不全悪化率、ケトアシドーシス、急性腎障害、尿路感染症、有害事象による中止率、左室駆出率（LVEF）の変化、ナトリウム利尿ペプチドの変化

items.title: Efficacy and Safety of Dual GLP-1/Glucagon Receptor Agonism in Overweight and Obesity: A Class-Specific Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Dual glucagon-like peptide-1/glucagon receptor (GLP-1/GCGR) agonists represent a novel obesity treatment class, but existing meta-analyses often conflate them with GIP-containing agents (tirzepatide, retatrutide) or restrict analysis to one or two drugs, leaving class-specific efficacy and safety incompletely characterized.
METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, Scopus and ClinicalTrials.gov through 20 July 2026 for randomized controlled trials of mazdutide, survodutide, cotadutide, and efinopegdutide in adults with overweight/obesity (PROSPERO CRD420261456447). Random-effects meta-analysis pooled mean differences (MDs) and risk ratios (RRs) with 95% CIs; heterogeneity, subgroup, sensitivity, GRADE and publication bias analyses were performed.
RESULTS: Nineteen RCTs were included. Dual agonists significantly reduced absolute body weight (MD: -6.65 kg, moderate certainty), relative weight (MD: -7.15%), and increased likelihood of ≥ 5% weight loss (RR: 4.75, low certainty), with mazdutide and survodutide showing the largest effects. Significant improvements occurred in HbA1c, BMI, waist circumference, systolic blood pressure and triglycerides. Any adverse events were more frequent with dual agonists (RR: 1.16), while serious adverse events did not differ from controls (RR: 0.90, high certainty).
CONCLUSION: Dual GLP-1/GCGR agonists produce meaningful weight loss and metabolic improvements with acceptable short-term safety, though longer head-to-head trials are needed to confirm durability and cardiovascular safety.
items.authors: Amjad Muhammad Maaz, Khan Muhammad Mustafa, Sarwar Fatima, Ali Aqsa, Ali Maham, Bakhash Faiza, Abid Humna, Ibrahim Farah
items.summary_ja: GLP-1/グルカゴン受容体二重作動薬（mazdutide、survodutide、cotadutide、efinopegdutide）の肥満・過体重成人におけるクラス特異的な有効性と安全性を評価した体系的レビューおよびメタ解析。PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library、Scopus、ClinicalTrials.govを2026年7月20日まで検索し、19件のRCTを含む。ランダム効果メタ解析により平均差（MD）とリスク比（RR）をプールし、異質性、サブグループ、感度、GRADE、出版バイアス解析を実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1/GCGR二重作動薬は絶対体重（MD: -6.65 kg）、相対体重（MD: -7.15%）、5%以上の減量達成率（RR: 4.75）において有意な改善を示し、HbA1c、BMI、腹囲、収縮期血圧、トリグリセリドも有意に改善した。有害事象は対照群より頻発（RR: 1.16）したが、重大有害事象には差がなかった（RR: 0.90）。
items.why_matters_ja: 既存のメタ解析はGIPを含む薬剤（tirzepatide、retatrutide）と混同したり、1〜2薬剤に限定したりしており、GLP-1/GCGR二重作動薬クラスとしての有効性と安全性が十分に特徴付けられていなかった。本解析はクラス特異的なエビデンスを初めて体系的に提示し、新規肥満治療クラスとしての位置づけを明確にする。
items.study_type_ja: 体系的レビューおよびメタ解析（ランダム化比較試験19件を含む）
items.endpoints_ja: 絶対体重、相対体重、5%以上の減量達成率、HbA1c、BMI、腹囲、収縮期血圧、トリグリセリド、有害事象（全有害事象）、重大有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: 絶対体重: MD -6.65 kg（中等度確実性）、相対体重: MD -7.15%、5%以上の減量達成率: RR 4.75（低確実性）、HbA1c: 有意改善（数値記載なし）、BMI: 有意改善（数値記載なし）、腹囲: 有意改善（数値記載なし）、収縮期血圧: 有意改善（数値記載なし）、トリグリセリド: 有意改善（数値記載なし）、全有害事象: RR 1.16、重大有害事象: RR 0.90（高確実性）

items.title: Oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist safiglipron in early type 2 diabetes: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
items.abstract: Safiglipron is an oral small-molecule glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist administered without fasting or dietary restrictions. We evaluated its efficacy and safety in OUTSTAND-1, a phase 3, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial at 46 sites in China. We randomized 284 adults with type 2 diabetes managed with diet and exercise alone (mean baseline HbA1c 7.95%, median diabetes duration 1.6 years, 33.1% women) to once-daily safiglipron 30 mg (n = 70), 60 mg (n = 70), 90 mg (n = 72) or placebo (n = 72) for 32 weeks, followed by a 20-week active-treatment extension. For the primary endpoint, placebo-adjusted treatment differences in HbA1c change from baseline to week 32 were -1.22% (95% CI, -1.53 to -0.91), -1.20% (95% CI, -1.52 to -0.89) and -1.45% (95% CI, -1.75 to -1.14) for 30 mg, 60 mg and 90 mg, respectively (all P < 0.0001; treatment policy estimand). Secondary outcomes showed HbA1c < 7.0% in 71.4-77.8% versus 25.0%, HbA1c ≤ 6.5% in 58.6-68.1% versus 16.7% and placebo-adjusted fasting plasma glucose differences of -1.58, -1.68 and -2.08 mmol l-1, respectively (all P < 0.0001). Body weight differences were modest (-0.65%, -2.23% and -3.56% versus placebo). Other secondary outcomes generally favored safiglipron for HbA1c < 5.7% attainment, postprandial glycemia, homeostatic model assessment of β cell function (HOMA-β), homeostatic model assessment of insulin resistance (HOMA-IR), disposition index and waist circumference, with less rescue therapy use. Insulin and C-peptide responses varied by dose, and changes in treatment satisfaction were limited. Gastrointestinal adverse events were most common and mostly mild or moderate. Adverse events led to treatment discontinuation in 1.4%, 2.9%, 6.9% and 0% of participants receiving safiglipron 30 mg, 60 mg, 90 mg and placebo, respectively. These findings support once-daily oral safiglipron as an effective treatment option for type 2 diabetes. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06672172 .
items.authors: Yu Miao, Peng Liang, Jiang Chengyan, Zhang Xianghua, Li Qifu, Zhang Lihui, Su Xiuhai, Zeng Zhaoyang
items.summary_ja: OUTSTAND-1は、中国の46施設で実施された第III相、多施設、無作為化、二重盲検、プラセボ対照試験であり、経口小分子GLP-1受容体作動薬safiglipronの早期2型糖尿病における有効性と安全性を評価した。食事と運動のみで管理されている284名の成人2型糖尿病患者（平均ベースラインHbA1c 7.95%、中央値糖尿病期間1.6年、女性33.1%）を、safiglipron 30 mg（n=70）、60 mg（n=70）、90 mg（n=72）、またはプラセボ（n=72）に無作為化し、32週間投与したのち20週間の活性治療延長期間を設けた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 経口小分子GLP-1受容体作動薬safiglipronは、早期2型糖尿病においてプラセボと比較してHbA1cを有意に低下させ（30 mgで-1.22%、60 mgで-1.20%、90 mgで-1.45%）、空腹時血糖や体重にも有益な効果を示し、2型糖尿病の有効な治療選択肢として支持された。
items.why_matters_ja: 絶食や食事制限なしで投与可能な経口小分子GLP-1受容体作動薬として、従来の注射型GLP-1 RAや経口SGLT2阻害薬とは異なる投与形態の選択肢を2型糖尿病治療に提供し、患者のアドヒアランス向上に寄与する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 第III相、多施設、無作為化、二重盲検、プラセボ対照試験
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：ベースラインから32週目までのHbA1c変化のプラセボ調整治療差。二次エンドポイント：HbA1c < 7.0%達成率、HbA1c ≤ 6.5%達成率、空腹時血糖のプラセボ調整差、体重差、HbA1c < 5.7%達成率、食後血糖、HOMA-β、HOMA-IR、disposition index、腹囲、救急療法使用率、インスリンおよびCペプチド応答、治療満足度、有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要エンドポイント（ベースラインから32週目までのHbA1c変化のプラセボ調整治療差）：30 mgで-1.22%（95% CI, -1.53 to -0.91）、60 mgで-1.20%（95% CI, -1.52 to -0.89）、90 mgで-1.45%（95% CI, -1.75 to -1.14）（いずれもP < 0.0001）。二次エンドポイント：HbA1c < 7.0%達成率は71.4-77.8% vs プラセボ25.0%、HbA1c ≤ 6.5%達成率は58.6-68.1% vs プラセボ16.7%、空腹時血糖のプラセボ調整差は-1.58、-1.68、-2.08 mmol/L（いずれもP < 0.0001）。体重差は-0.65%、-2.23%、-3.56%（vs プラセボ）。有害事象による治療中止率は1.4%、2.9%、6.9%、0%（30 mg、60 mg、90 mg、プラセボ）。
items.sample_size_ja: 284名（safiglipron 30 mg: n=70、60 mg: n=70、90 mg: n=72、プラセボ: n=72）

items.title: Bariatric Surgery, Medical Weight Loss, and the Upper Aerodigestive Tract.
items.abstract: Obesity and intentional weight loss increasingly influence otolaryngologic disease through mechanical, metabolic, inflammatory, gastrointestinal, and regional soft-tissue effects. This review examines how bariatric surgery and contemporary medical weight-loss therapies affect the upper aerodigestive tract. Evidence is strongest for obstructive sleep apnea, in which substantial weight reduction improves disease severity but does not ensure remission. Emerging data suggest potential benefits for chronic rhinosinusitis and selected voice outcomes, alongside risks such as procedure-specific reflux, chronic cough, delayed gastric emptying, nutritional complications, and patulous Eustachian tube dysfunction. Otolaryngologists should incorporate the weight-loss method, magnitude, rate, and durability into evaluation, counseling, and perioperative planning.
items.authors: Samreen Sarah, Hutter Mattew M
items.summary_ja: 肥満と意図的な減量が、機械的・代謝的・炎症性・消化管・局所軟部組織の経路を通じて耳鼻咽喉科疾患に影響を与えることを背景に、肥満手術と最新の医療的減量療法が上部気道消化管に与える影響をレビューした。最も確かな証拠は閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸（OSA）であり、大幅な減量で病態の重症度が改善するが、寛解を保証するものではない。慢性副鼻腔炎や一部の音声アウトカムに対する潜在的な利点、および術式特有の逆流、慢性咳嗽、胃排出遅延、栄養合併症、耳管開放症などのリスクについても言及している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満手術や医療的減量療法による大幅な減量はOSAの重症度改善に最も確かな証拠があるが、寛解を保証するものではない。また、術式特有の逆流や慢性咳嗽などのリスクも存在し、耳鼻咽喉科医は減量方法・程度・速度・持続性を評価・カウンセリング・術前計画に組み込むべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満治療の選択肢が拡大する中、耳鼻咽喉科医が上部気道消化管疾患の管理において減量療法の種類・程度・速度・持続性を考慮に入れることが、患者の評価・カウンセリング・術前計画の質を高めるため重要である。

items.endpoints_ja: 閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸の重症度、慢性副鼻腔炎、音声アウトカム、術式特有の逆流、慢性咳嗽、胃排出遅延、栄養合併症、耳管開放症

items.title: Comparative Weight-Loss Outcomes Following Initiation of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists versus SGLT2 Inhibitors: A Real-World Active Comparator Study.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To compare 12-month weight loss between GLP-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) and SGLT2 inhibitor (SGLT2i) initiators and assess effect modification by diabetes status, sex, and race/ethnicity in a diverse US cohort.
METHODS: Retrospective active comparator new-user cohort study using the NIH All of Us Research Program (2018-2023). We identified 2,932 SGLT2i-naïve GLP-1RA initiators and 941 GLP-1RA-naïve SGLT2i initiators aged 18-80 with BMI ≥27 kg/m2 and available weight measurements. Inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) with a 17-covariate propensity score model - including heart failure and CKD - achieved balance on all 28 diagnostics (maximum SMD 0.077). The primary outcome was percent body weight change at 12 months; secondary outcomes included ≥10% weight loss, HbA1c, and blood pressure change.
RESULTS: After IPTW, GLP-1RA initiators lost more weight than SGLT2i initiators (difference -1.20 pp [95% CI, -1.91 to -0.48]; P = .001; OR 1.75 [95% CI, 1.40-2.19]; RR 1.61 [95% CI, 1.19-2.03]; NNT 14), concentrated in obesity-only patients (-1.96 pp; P <.001) but absent in type 2 diabetes (+0.08 pp; interaction P = .006). Sex modified the effect (P = .017): -1.71 pp in women vs +0.12 pp in men. HbA1c decreased more with GLP-1RA (-0.261%; P = .032); blood pressure did not differ significantly.
CONCLUSION: GLP-1RA initiators achieved greater weight loss than SGLT2i initiators, concentrated in women and patients without type 2 diabetes, supporting individualized treatment selection. Interaction findings are hypothesis-generating and require prospective confirmation.

items.authors: Milanov Valentin
items.summary_ja: NIH All of Us Research Program（2018-2023年）のデータを用いた後方視的アクティブコンパレーター・ニューユーザーコホート研究。BMI≥27 kg/m²の18-80歳患者において、GLP-1受容体アゴニスト（GLP-1RA）開始群（n=2,932）とSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）開始群（n=941）の12か月後の体重減少を比較し、糖尿病の有無・性別・人種/民族による効果修飾を評価した。17変数のプロピensityスコアモデルによる逆確率治療重み付け（IPTW）を実施し、28項目の診断バランスを達成（最大SMD 0.077）。主要エンドポイントは12か月時の体重変化率、副次エンドポイントは10%以上の体重減少、HbA1c、血圧変化。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RA開始群はSGLT2i開始群より12か月時の体重減少が有意に大きかったが、この差は女性および2型糖尿病を有さない患者に集中しており、2型糖尿病を有する患者では差は認められなかった（交互作用P=.006）。
items.why_matters_ja: 糖尿病の有無や性別によってGLP-1RAとSGLT2iの減量効果の差が異なることを示し、個別化治療選択の根拠を提供する。ただし交互作用の所見は仮説生成段階であり、前向き研究による確認が必要とされている。

items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：12か月時の体重変化率（percent body weight change at 12 months）。副次エンドポイント：10%以上の体重減少、HbA1c変化、血圧変化。

items.title: Comparative outcomes of GLP-1 receptor agonist and SGLT2 inhibitor users after liver transplantation: An emulated target trial.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: We emulated a target trial to compare glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) with sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) regarding hepatic, cardiovascular, and mortality outcomes among liver transplant recipients with diabetes.
METHODS: Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network, we identified 33,161 liver transplant recipients with diabetes between 2015 and 2024. After propensity score matching, 564 pairs of new GLP-1 RA and SGLT2i users were analyzed. Risks of infection, graft rejection, cirrhosis, cardiovascular outcomes, hospitalization, and mortality were estimated using Cox proportional hazards models.
RESULTS: The mean age was 65.8 years (SD, 10.8), and 65.1% were male. Compared with SGLT2i use, GLP-1 RA use was associated with lower risks of cirrhosis (HR, 0.787; 95% CI, 0.619-0.999), ischemic heart disease (HR, 0.721; 95% CI, 0.582-0.892), heart failure (HR, 0.502; 95% CI, 0.388-0.650), and all-cause mortality (HR, 0.622; 95% CI, 0.433-0.894). No significant differences were observed for infection, graft rejection, liver failure, or all-cause hospitalization. Sensitivity analyses generally supported the cardiovascular and mortality findings, whereas the association with cirrhosis was less consistent across propensity score models.
CONCLUSIONS: Among liver transplant recipients with diabetes, GLP-1 RA use was associated with lower risks of ischemic heart disease, heart failure, and all-cause mortality compared with SGLT2i use. A lower risk of cirrhosis was also observed, although this association was of borderline statistical significance and was not consistently significant across alternative models. Given the observational design, these findings do not establish causality and warrant prospective confirmation.
items.authors: Yen Fu-Shun, Liao Pei-Lun, Hung Yao-Min, Hsu Chih-Cheng, Liu Chin-Su, Hou Ming-Chih, Hwu Chii-Min, Wei James Cheng-Chung
items.summary_ja: 肝移植受容者における糖尿病治療薬としてGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）とSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）の比較を目的としたエミュレート・ターゲット・トライアルである。TriNetX US Collaborative Networkを用い、2015年から2024年までに肝移植を受けた糖尿病患者33,161例を同定し、プロパensity score matchingにより564ペア（計1,128例）を解析した。Cox比例ハザードモデルを用いて、感染、移植片拒絶反応、肝硬変、心血管アウトカム、入院、死亡率のリスクを推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肝移植受容者における糖尿病患者において、SGLT2i使用と比較してGLP-1 RA使用は虚血性心疾患（HR 0.721）、心不全（HR 0.502）、全死因死亡率（HR 0.622）のリスク低下と関連した。肝硬変のリスク低下も観察されたが、統計的有意性は境界的であり、代替モデル間で一貫しなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 肝移植受容者という特殊かつ脆弱な集団において、2つの主要な糖尿病治療薬クラスを直接比較した観察研究であり、この集団における薬剤選択の臨床的根拠を提供する可能性がある。ただし観察研究であり因果関係は確立されていない。
items.study_type_ja: エミュレート・ターゲット・トライアル（観察研究、プロパensity score matching適用）
items.endpoints_ja: 感染、移植片拒絶反応、肝硬変、虚血性心疾患、心不全、肝不全、全死因入院、全死因死亡率

items.title: Estimating the Wider Societal Impact of Semaglutide Across Multiple Indications in Canada: an Economic Evaluation.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Medical treatments may deliver individual, healthcare and societal impact across multiple indications. Assessing impact is challenging due to a focus on individual-level and indication-specific costs/benefits using narrow healthcare perspectives. A multi-indication model was developed for Canada to evaluate the wider societal impacts of semaglutide.
METHOD: A population-level analysis estimated the 5-year (2025-2029) impact of semaglutide in a hypothetical population of 1,000,000 eligible treated Canadians with T2D, CV disease, MASH and/or CKD. Baseline prevalence and overlaps were estimated from published data. Treatment effects were derived from clinical trial comparisons of semaglutide vs standard care. Health care resource use reduction and cost-converted environmental impact was calculated from prevalence differences in control and treatment groups. Productivity was quantified using a US-based quality-of-life driven model.
RESULTS: Among treated individuals, 50% had 1 condition, 27% had 2, and 23% had ≥3 at baseline. Model analysis projected up to 235,000 fewer obesity cases and prevention by 2029 of 650 T2D cases, 8,400 CV events, 1,100 CV deaths, 5,300 MASH stage 3-4 cases, 2,200 stage 4 CKD/end-stage renal disease cases, and 48,800 obesity- and T2D-related complications, although 21,200 gastrointestinal adverse events were estimated to occur. Treatment with semaglutide was estimated to avoid 22,200 hospitalisations and 330kt CO2e, with estimated HCRU cost reductions of CAD 2.0billion and modelled productivity gains of CAD 19.9billion, offsetting CAD 20.4billion semaglutide (1mg, 2.4mg) treatment costs. Results were most sensitive to baseline utility values.
CONCLUSION: Modelled 5-year impacts of semaglutide treatment suggest potential wide-ranging individual, healthcare and societal benefits across cardiometabolic comorbidities that are not captured in traditional narrow healthcare perspectives.

items.summary_ja: カナダにおけるセマグルチドの多適応症（T2D、心血管疾患、MASH、CKD）に対する広範な社会的影響を評価するため、100万人の仮想的治療対象人口を対象とした5年間（2025-2029年）の人口レベルのモデル分析を行った経済評価研究。臨床試験由来の治療効果、医療資源使用の削減、環境影響のコスト換算、生産性向上を統合的に算出した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチド治療は、心血管代謝性合併症にわたる個人・医療・社会レベルの広範な利益をもたらす可能性があり、従来の狭い医療者視点では捉えられない社会的価値を定量化した。
items.why_matters_ja: 従来の費用効果分析は個人レベル・適応症特異的なコスト/ベネフィットに焦点を当てており、多適応症にわたる社会的影響を過小評価する可能性がある。本研究は、セマグルチドの広範な社会的価値を定量化し、政策決定や価値評価の枠組みに示唆を与える。

items.endpoints_ja: 肥満症例数、T2D症例数、心血管イベント数、心血管死亡数、MASH stage 3-4症例数、stage 4 CKD/末期腎不全症例数、肥満・T2D関連合併症数、消化管有害事象数、入院件数、CO2e排出量、医療資源使用コスト削減額、生産性向上額、セマグルチド治療コスト

items.title: Potential bone marrow-driven reduction of circulating inflammatory monocytes by semaglutide in Type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) reduce cardiovascular disease (CVD) in type 2 diabetes (T2D) and have anti-inflammatory effects in experimental studies, but their mechanism of action in humans remains unclear. This study characterized the cardiovascular-haematopoietic axis in individuals with T2D receiving semaglutide, as a potential mediator of GLP-1RA cardioprotective properties.
METHODS: In 16 individuals with T2D [63.2 ± 6.1 years, 37.5% female, weight 82.3 ± 15.3 kg, body mass index (BMI) 28.33 ± 3.5 kg/m2, LDL cholesterol 2.2 ± 0.9 mmol/L, glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) 78.1 ± 13.1 mmol/mol, high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) 1.9 (1.2, 5.8) mg/L], blood and sternal bone marrow aspirates (subset, n = 14) were collected at baseline and after 6 months of semaglutide ≤2.0 mg weekly. Circulating monocytes and haematopoietic precursors were quantified by flow cytometry, plasma cytokines using an nELISA™ assay (Nomic Bio) and inflammatory macrophages in coronary arteries, bone marrow, and spleen by gallium-68-labelled DOTA-(Tyr3)-octreotate (68Ga-DOTATATE) positron emission tomography-computed tomography scans.
RESULTS: After 6 months of semaglutide, significant reductions in HbA1c (-21.1 mmol/mol, P < .0001), weight (-6.7 kg, P < .001), BMI (-2.5 kg/m2, P < .001), and hsCRP (-1.0 mg/L, P = .005) were observed. Circulating CD16+ monocytes were markedly lower (-18.8%, P = .034), with increased bone marrow retention correlating with weight loss, alongside reductions in interleukin-1 receptor antagonist, leptin, E-selectin, intercellular adhesion molecule-1 (ICAM-1), C-C motif chemokine ligand 2, C-C motif chemokine ligand 11, and C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 13. Gallium-68-labelled DOTA-(Tyr3)-octreotate PET-CT showed lower bone marrow uptake (-17.5%, P = .037), but not in spleen or coronary arteries.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide in T2D potentially reduces circulating inflammatory monocytes, increases bone marrow retention, and lowers markers of endothelial inflammation, with no reduction in coronary artery inflammatory macrophages. Semaglutide is associated with lower bone marrow 68Ga-DOTATATE uptake, which may relate to anti-inflammatory effects relevant to CVD risk.

items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病（T2D）患者16名を対象に、セマグルチド（週1回2.0 mg以下）投与6ヶ月前後で血液および胸骨骨髄穿刺液（サブセット n=14）を採取し、フローサイトメトリーによる循環単球・造血前駆細胞、nELISAによる血漿サイトカイン、68Ga-DOTATATE PET-CTによる冠動脈・骨髄・脾臓の炎症性マクロファージを評価した前向き単一アーム観察研究。
items.key_takeaway_ja: T2D患者におけるセマグルチド投与により、循環CD16+単球が有意に減少（-18.8%）、骨髄内留留が増加し、骨髄の68Ga-DOTATATE取り込みが有意に低下（-17.5%）したが、冠動脈の炎症性マクロファージには減少が認められなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）はT2Dで心血管疾患（CVD）を減少させるが、ヒトにおける作用機序は不明であった。本研究は心血管-造血軸をGLP-1RAの心保護作用の潜在的な媒介因子として特徴づけ、CVDリスクに関連する抗炎症効果の機序解明に寄与する。

items.title: Beyond weight loss: a narrative review of tirzepatide's impact on muscle and lean mass in people with overweight and obesity.
items.abstract: Tirzepatide, a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, has demonstrated substantial efficacy for weight loss in individuals with overweight and obesity. However, the extent to which this weight reduction affects lean mass remains unclear. This review evaluates current evidence on the impact of tirzepatide on body composition, with a particular focus on changes in lean mass and its proxy measures. A structured literature search identified ten studies, including randomized controlled trials, observational studies and modelling analyses, encompassing diverse populations with and without type 2 diabetes mellitus. Across studies, tirzepatide consistently produced large, dose-dependent reductions in body weight. These reductions were predominantly attributable to fat mass, although decreases in lean mass, fat-free mass or skeletal muscle mass were observed in all studies. The proportion of total weight loss attributable to lean mass generally ranged from 10% to 30%, broadly aligning with expected physiological responses to weight loss. However, substantial heterogeneity in study design, population characteristics, and body composition assessment methods limits the ability to draw definitive conclusions. Most studies relied on indirect measures such as bioelectrical impedance analysis, with limited use of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry. Importantly, functional outcomes were not assessed, and the clinical significance of observed lean mass reductions remains uncertain. Overall, tirzepatide appears to promote preferential fat loss, though some loss of lean mass occurs. Strategies such as resistance training and adequate protein intake may help mitigate potential adverse effects on muscle mass during treatment.
items.authors: Wilkinson Thomas, Ramzan Rishada
items.summary_ja: 肥満・過体重患者におけるtirzepatide（GLP-1/GIP受容体二重作動薬）の体組成、特にlean mass（除脂肪量）およびその代理指標への影響を評価したナラティブレビュー。構造化文献検索により、ランダム化比較試験、観察研究、モデリング解析を含む10件の研究を特定し、T2DM有無を問わず多様な集団を対象に検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Tirzepatideは体重減少を大きくもたらすが、その減少は主に脂肪量に起因する。全体重減少に占めるlean mass減少の割合は概ね10〜30%の範囲であり、脂肪優位の減少パターンを示すが、lean massの減少も全研究で観察された。
items.why_matters_ja: Tirzepatideは体重減少に高い有効性を示すが、lean mass減少の臨床的意義は不確実であり、機能アウトカムが評価されていない。筋量減少が患者の機能や予後に与える影響を考慮した上で、レジスタンストレーニングや十分なタンパク質摂取などの対策が治療中に重要である。

items.title: Semaglutide for Treating Paediatric Craniopharyngioma-Related Obesity: A Multicentre Case Series.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Obesity is a complication of childhood craniopharyngioma that remains difficult to treat. We investigated whether semaglutide was associated with a decrease in BMI among adolescents with craniopharyngioma-related obesity.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: This multicentre retrospective study included 20 patients < 18 years old with craniopharyngioma and obesity (BMI > 2 WHO Z-score) from 2019 to 2024 (source population: 139 children with craniopharyngioma, including 36 children with obesity). They received off-label semaglutide with dose titration (0.25-2 mg/week), tailored to tolerance and clinical response. The primary outcome was the within-patient comparison of BMI change from -12 months to treatment initiation and from initiation to +12 months.
RESULTS: At semaglutide initiation, patients were 14.0 ± 3.9 years old, the interval since craniopharyngioma diagnosis was 6.3 ± 4.7 years, and BMI was 33.4 ± 3.9 kg/m2 (3.2 ± 0.7 Z-score). Tumour treatment was surgery alone (8/20), surgery and proton therapy (11/20), or proton therapy alone (1/20). All patients had growth hormone and TSH deficiency; 19/20 had ACTH and AVP deficiency. In the year before treatment, patients gained 3.5 ± 4.4 kg/m2 in BMI and 0.6 ± 1.6 in BMI Z-score; after 1 year of semaglutide therapy, they lost 2.5 ± 3.9 kg/m2 in BMI and 0.5 ± 0.5 in BMI Z-score (paired comparisons, p < 0.001 and p = 0.004, respectively). During treatment, BMI decreased by 10% or more in 40% of patients (95% CI: 19%-64%). Gastrointestinal side effects occurred in 30% of patients but were mild. No cases of treatment discontinuation, pituitary insufficiency decompensation or tumour recurrence were observed.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide was associated with reversal of weight gain among adolescents with craniopharyngioma-related obesity.
items.authors: Dornberger Joanne, Barat Pascal, Aouchiche Karine, Perge Kevin, Villanueva Carine, Castets Sarah, Bouhours-Nouet Natacha, Donzeau Aurelie
items.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋咽頭腫関連肥満は治療が困難な合併症である。本多施設後ろ向き研究では、2019年から2024年にかけて、頭蓋咽頭腫を合併し肥満（BMI > 2 WHO Z-score）を有する18歳未満の20例を対象に、オフラベルのセマグルチド（0.25〜2 mg/週、用量漸増）のBMIへの影響を評価した。主要アウトカムは、治療開始前12ヶ月から開始時、および開始時から+12ヶ月までのBMI変化の患者内比較であった。治療開始時、患者の平均年齢は14.0±3.9歳、BMIは33.4±3.9 kg/m²（3.2±0.7 Z-score）であった。治療前1年間でBMIは3.5±4.4 kg/m²増加したが、セマグルチド投与1年後にはBMIが2.5±3.9 kg/m²、BMI Z-scoreが0.5±0.5減少した（対比較、p<0.001、p=0.004）。40%の患者でBMIが10%以上減少した（95% CI: 19%〜64%）。消化管副作用は30%で軽度であり、治療中断、下垂体機能不全の失代償、腫瘍再発は観察されなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドは、頭蓋咽頭腫関連肥満を有する思春期患者において体重増加の反転と関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: 小児頭蓋咽頭腫に伴う肥満は治療が困難な合併症であり、本ケースシリーズはセマグルチドのオフラベル使用における有効性と安全性の初期証拠を提供する。

items.title: Targeting the aldosterone-mineralocorticoid receptor pathway in cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome.
items.abstract: The concept of cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome integrates cardiovascular, kidney and metabolic disorders into a single pathophysiological continuum characterized by chronic inflammation, oxidative stress, fibrosis and progressive organ dysfunction. A central driver of CKM syndrome progression is inappropriate activation of the aldosterone-mineralocorticoid receptor (MR) pathway, which promotes adverse remodelling of the heart, kidney, vasculature, adipose tissue, liver and pancreas. Steroidal MR antagonists (MRAs) and non-steroidal MRAs mitigate maladaptive MR signalling and improve cardiorenal outcomes. Compared with steroidal MRAs, non-steroidal MRAs such as finerenone provide enhanced tissue selectivity and favourable safety profiles. Finerenone has been shown to reduce cardiovascular and renal events in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and in patients with heart failure. Aldosterone synthase inhibitors represent a complementary approach that suppresses aldosterone production upstream of MR activation and has shown promising results in resistant hypertension and CKD. Preclinical and clinical data indicate that combined strategies targeting the aldosterone-MR axis can attenuate cardiorenal remodelling, insulin resistance and organ injury, offering a comprehensive therapeutic approach. Ongoing trials will clarify the efficacy of these combined therapies in non-diabetic CKD, resistant hypertension and broader CKM syndrome populations. Overall, targeting the aldosterone-MR pathway represents a central strategy to reduce organ dysfunction, improve metabolic homeostasis and limit progression of CKM syndrome.
items.authors: Sánchez-Bayuela Tania, Barrera-Chimal Jonatan, Jaisser Frederic
items.summary_ja: 心血管・腎・代謝（CKM）症候群は、慢性炎症・酸化ストレス・線維化・進行性臓器障害を特徴とする単一の病生理学的連続体として心血管・腎・代謝疾患を統合する概念である。CKM症候群の進行の中心的な駆動因子は、アルドステロン-ミネラルコルチコイド受容体（MR）経路の不適切な活性化であり、心臓・腎臓・血管・脂肪組織・肝臓・膵臓の有害なリモデリングを促進する。ステロイド系MR拮抗薬（MRA）および非ステロイド系MRAは不適切なMRシグナルを軽減し、心腎アウトカムを改善する。非ステロイド系MRA（フィネレノン）はステロイド系MRAと比較して組織選択性が高く、安全性プロファイルが良好である。フィネレノンは慢性腎臓病（CKD）患者および心不全患者において心血管イベントおよび腎イベントを減少させることが示されている。アルドステロンシンターゼ阻害薬はMR活性化の上流でアルドステロン産生を抑制する補完的アプローチであり、抵抗性高血圧およびCKDで有望な結果を示している。前臨床および臨床データは、アルドステロン-MR軸を標的とする複合戦略が心腎リモデリング、インスリン抵抗性、臓器障害を軽減しうることを示唆している。進行中の試験が、非糖尿病CKD、抵抗性高血圧、より広いCKM症候群集団におけるこれらの複合療法の有効性を明確にする。
items.key_takeaway_ja: アルドステロン-MR経路を標的とすることは、臓器障害の軽減、代謝恒常性の改善、CKM症候群の進行抑制のための中心的戦略である。
items.why_matters_ja: CKM症候群は心血管・腎・代謝疾患を単一の病生理学的連続体として統合し、アルドステロン-MR経路の不適切な活性化がその進行の中心的な駆動因子である。この経路を標的とする治療戦略（MRA、アルドステロンシンターゼ阻害薬、複合戦略）は、多臓器障害の軽減と代謝恒常性の改善に寄与しうる。

items.title: Safety profile of Finerenone: Pooled analysis of different types of arrhythmic events.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Finerenone reduces kidney and cardiovascular events in patients with chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus, but its safety profile in terms of arrhythmic outcomes remains uncertain.
METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov (inception-March 2026) for randomized trials reporting arrhythmias or conduction disorders with finerenone versus control. Risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using fixed-effects models; heterogeneity was assessed with I2.
RESULTS: Six trials (21,015 patients; mean age 67.2 years; 33.9% women) were included. Finerenone was not associated with increased atrial or ventricular arrhythmias, high-grade atrioventricular block, or cardiac arrest (all RRs non-significant; low heterogeneity).
CONCLUSIONS: Finerenone shows no clear increase in clinically reported arrhythmic events in the pooled analysis; however, the included studies were not designed to assess the rate of arrhythmic outcomes and might have underestimated the true rates.
items.authors: Bazoukis George, Clarke Esther Victoria, Tse Gary
items.summary_ja: 慢性腎臓病および2型糖尿病を有する患者におけるフィネレノンの不整脈関連安全性を評価するため、PubMed、Cochrane Library、ClinicalTrials.gov（創刊〜2026年3月）から不整脈または伝導障害を報告したランダム化試験を体系的に検索し、フィネレノン群と対照群のリスク比（RR）を固定効果モデルでプール解析した。6試験（21,015例；平均年齢67.2歳；女性33.9%）が対象となり、フィネレノンは心房性・心室性不整脈、高度房室ブロック、心停止のいずれとも有意な関連は認められなかった（全RR有意差なし；低異質性）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: プール解析において、フィネレノンは臨床的に報告された不整脈事象の増加を示さなかったが、対象試験は不整脈事象の発生率を評価する目的で設計されておらず、真の発生率を過小評価している可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: フィネレノンは慢性腎臓病・2型糖尿病患者で腎・心血管イベントを減少させることが知られているが、不整脈に関する安全性プロファイルは不確実であった。本解析は、不整脈事象の増加を示す明確な証拠がないことを示す一方、対象試験の設計上の限界（不整脈評価が主要目的でない）を指摘し、解釈における注意を喚起している。

items.title: Peer Referral Pathways and 6-Month Outcomes in a Tirzepatide-Supported Digital Weight Loss Service: Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.abstract: In a retrospective analysis of 34,449 adults using an unsubsidized, tirzepatide-supported digital weight loss service (DWLS) in Australia, patients entering via peer referral showed higher 6-month program adherence and greater percentage weight loss than propensity score-matched nonreferred patients, suggesting that peer referral pathways may support retention and effectiveness in medicated obesity care.
items.authors: Talay Louis, Swinckels Laura, Hom Jason, Tan Marilyn, Ahuja Neera
items.summary_ja: オーストラリアの非補助型tirzepatide併用デジタル減量サービス（DWLS）を利用した34,449人の成人を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。ピア紹介経由で入会した患者は、傾向スコアマッチングによる非紹介患者と比較して、6ヶ月間のプログラム継続率が高く、体重減少率も大きかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ピア紹介経路は、薬剤併用肥満治療における患者の継続率と減量効果の向上に関連する可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 薬剤併用肥満治療のデジタルサービスにおいて、ピア紹介という低コストの介入が患者の定着と治療効果に寄与し得ることを示唆し、サービス設計や患者エンゲージメント戦略に示唆を与える。

items.title: New Amylin-Based Agonists for the Treatment of Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and obesity represent two major global health challenges. Amylin-based agonists offer a promising perspective. Three frontrunner agents of this class are increasingly being investigated: zenagamtide, eloralintide and cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema).
METHODS: A search in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus and Google Scholar was conducted with the use of appropriate keywords until June 2026 for this narrative review.
RESULTS: Zenagamtide (formerly known as amycretin), a unimolecular long-lasting amylin and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) co-agonist, achieved weight loss up to 13.1% (phase 1 study, 85 days) in obesity trials as an oral formulation and up to 24.3% (phase 1b/2a study, 36 weeks) as a subcutaneous formulation. Moreover, eloralintide, a long-acting mostly amylin type 1 receptor (AMY1R) agonist, achieved weight loss up to 20.1% (phase 2 study, 48 weeks), and CagriSema resulted in weight loss up to 22.7% (phase 3a study, 68 weeks). All these agents reduced body mass index (BMI) and waist circumference (WC). In T2DM, CagriSema reduced glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) by up to 2.0% (trial product estimand, phase 3a study, 68 weeks) and is currently the most well-studied agent in T2DM. In treatment-naïve people with T2DM, this agent has been successfully used, leading even to T2DM remission in approximately one out of two CagriSema users (phase 3a, 40 weeks). In individuals with T2DM receiving basal insulin, it reduced insulin dose by 20 units compared with the control arm (phase 3a, 40 weeks). The safety profile of amycretin and CagriSema is overall consistent with that of glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs). Preliminary evidence suggests that eloralintide, as an AMY1R monoagonist, was associated with a distinct adverse events profile, including fatigue, headache and appetite loss.
CONCLUSIONS: These agents hold therapeutic potential in the management of both T2DM and obesity, as shown by preliminary clinical trial outcomes. Further trials are now needed to validate them in clinical practice.

items.authors: Panou Theodoros, Gouveri Evanthia, Popovic Djordje S, Papanas Nikolaos
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、肥満および2型糖尿病（T2DM）の治療におけるアミリンベースのagonist（zenagamtide、eloralintide、CagriSema）に関するナラティブレビューである。PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Google Scholarを用いて2026年6月まで検索を実施した。zenagamtideは経口投与で最大13.1%（第1相、85日）、皮下投与で最大24.3%（第1b/2a相、36週間）の減量を達成し、eloralintideは最大20.1%（第2相、48週間）、CagriSemaは最大22.7%（第3a相、68週間）の減量を達成した。T2DMにおいてCagriSemaはHbA1cを最大2.0%低下させ（第3a相、68週間）、治療経験のないT2DM患者では約半数にT2DM寛解を達成し（第3a相、40週間）、基礎インスリン併用患者では対照群比でインスリン用量を20単位減少させた（第3a相、40週間）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: アミリンベースのagonist（zenagamtide、eloralintide、CagriSema）は肥満およびT2DMの両方に治療的潜在力を持ち、特にCagriSemaはT2DMにおいて最も研究が進んでおり、治療経験のない患者では約半数に寛解を達成した。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DMと肥満は世界的な主要な健康課題であり、アミリンベースのagonistはこれらの疾患管理において有望な治療選択肢を提供する可能性がある。

items.title: Combined Semaglutide and Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitor Use and Metabolic Outcomes in Chinese Adults With Diabetes: Post Hoc Analysis.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Real-world use of once-weekly semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes in China has been shown in SCHOLAR. This post hoc analysis investigated the use of combination semaglutide-sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor (SGLT2i) treatment, glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) changes, and safety in a subset of SCHOLAR participants.
METHODS: Participants from SCHOLAR were included in this post hoc, single-arm analysis if they were prescribed once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide and had ≥ 1 SGLT2i prescription within 6 months of initiating semaglutide. Participants were grouped according to whether semaglutide use was continuous or not and by baseline HbA1c (≥ 7%). We evaluated the proportion of SCHOLAR participants prescribed combined semaglutide-SGLT2i. Key endpoints were: change in HbA1c from baseline to month 6; proportion of participants achieving a HbA1c level  < 7% at month 6; change in lipid profile from baseline to month 6; and safety profile of combined semaglutide-SGLT2i.
RESULTS: A total of 11,361 (42.3%) SCHOLAR participants were treated with combined semaglutide-SGLT2i. Mean change in HbA1c (95% confidence interval [CI]) from baseline to month 6 was - 0.64%-points (- 0.71, - 0.56) (p < 0.0001) for the overall combined semaglutide-SGLT2i group. The greatest change was seen in the continuous semaglutide group with baseline HbA1c ≥ 7% (- 1.20%-points [95% CI - 1.36, - 1.04]). The proportion of participants with HbA1c levels  < 7% increased from 37.8% at baseline to 55.1% at month 6 for the overall combined treatment group. There were significant reductions in mean total cholesterol (p < 0.0001), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (p < 0.0001), and triglycerides (p = 0.0043) as well as a significant increase in high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (p < 0.0001). Gastrointestinal adverse events were most frequent.
CONCLUSIONS: Combined semaglutide-SGLT2i treatment was prevalent in this subset of the SCHOLAR population and associated with significant reduction in HbA1c and changes in lipid profile. The safety profile of combined semaglutide-SGLT2i was similar to the overall SCHOLAR population.

items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドとSGLT2阻害薬の併用治療はHbA1cの有意な低下と脂質プロファイルの改善と関連し、安全性プロファイルはSCHOLAR全体集団と同様であった。

items.title: Risk factors for recurrent urinary tract infection after SGLT2 inhibitor reinitiation in type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: To determine the risk of recurrent urinary tract infection (UTI) after early reinitiation of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) in adults with type 2 diabetes and to identify patient-level factors associated with recurrence.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study. Adults with type 2 diabetes who discontinued an SGLT2i after an index UTI and were subsequently restarted were classified by reinitiation timing (early vs delayed). Recurrent UTI was defined as a new, clinically coded episode following reinitiation. Multivariable models assessed associations between recurrence and demographics, comorbidities, glycemic control, renal function, and psychiatric history.
RESULTS: Among 316 patients who restarted SGLT2i within 21 days during or after the first UTI episode, recurrent UTI occurred in 43.99% after 14 days post-reinitiation. In the combined cohort (n = 395), early reinitiation (<21 days) showed a trend toward increased recurrence risk compared to delayed reinitiation (≥21 days) in unadjusted Cox regression (HR 1.348; 95% CI 0.948-1.915; p = 0.096) and logistic regression (OR 1.305; 95% CI 0.797-2.139; p = 0.290), though neither reached statistical significance. After adjusting for baseline covariates, the trend persisted (adjusted Cox HR 2.011; 95% CI 0.973-4.158; p = 0.0592). In univariable Cox regression analysis of the combined cohort, female sex (HR 0.649 for males; 95% CI 0.448-0.942), higher HbA1c (HR 1.09 per %; 95% CI 1.004-1.184), and reduced eGFR (HR 0.992 per ml/min/1.73 m²; 95% CI 0.987-0.998) were identified as factors significantly associated with recurrence.
CONCLUSIONS: In this retrospective cohort of patients whose UTI was clinically coded and treated with antibiotics, recurrence was less frequent among men with preserved renal function and lower HbA1c, suggesting early SGLT2i reinitiation is a reasonable option in this subgroup. No conclusion could be drawn for higher-risk patients. The comparison of early versus delayed reinitiation remained inconclusive: the point estimate favored delayed reinitiation but did not reach significance (adjusted HR 2.011; 95% CI 0.973-4.158). In univariable analysis, female sex, older age, poor glycemic control, and impaired renal function were associated with recurrence. As ascertainment required a coded encounter and an antibiotic prescription, these findings apply only to clinically significant episodes. Randomized trials are needed to define optimal timing.
items.authors: Hsueh Yu-Chu, Lin Chia-Hung, Liu Pi-Hua, Lin Yi-Hsuan
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病においてSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）を中断後に再開した成人を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。最初の尿路感染症（UTI）後にSGLT2iを再開した患者を再開タイミング（早期＜21日 vs 遅延≥21日）で分類し、再開後の再発UTIのリスクおよび関連する患者レベルの因子を多変量モデルで評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 早期再開（＜21日）は再発リスク増加の傾向を示したが統計的有意差には達しなかった（調整後Cox HR 2.011; 95% CI 0.973-4.158; p=0.0592）。単変量解析では、女性、高齢、血糖コントロール不良（HbA1c上昇）、腎機能低下が再発と有意に関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2iはUTIリスクを高めることが知られており、UTI後の再開タイミングは臨床的に重要な判断事項である。本研究は、男性・腎機能保存・HbA1cが低い患者では早期再開が合理的な選択肢である可能性を示唆する一方、高リスク患者では結論が得られず、最適な再開タイミングを決定するためにはランダム化比較試験が必要であることを示している。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的コホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: SGLT2i再開後の再発尿路感染症（UTI）の発生
items.endpoint_results_ja: 21日以内にSGLT2iを再開した316例中、再開後14日で再発UTIが43.99%に発生。統合コホート（n=395）において、早期再開（＜21日）vs 遅延再開（≥21日）の比較：非調整Cox回帰 HR 1.348（95% CI 0.948-1.915; p=0.096）、ロジスティック回帰 OR 1.305（95% CI 0.797-2.139; p=0.290）、いずれも統計的有意差なし。ベースライン共変量調整後Cox HR 2.011（95% CI 0.973-4.158; p=0.0592）。単変量Cox回帰：男性（HR 0.649; 95% CI 0.448-0.942）、HbA1c上昇（HR 1.09 per %; 95% CI 1.004-1.184）、eGFR低下（HR 0.992 per ml/min/1.73m²; 95% CI 0.987-0.998）が再発と有意に関連。
items.sample_size_ja: 21日以内にSGLT2iを再開した患者316例、統合コホートn=395

items.title: Effectiveness of Finerenone in Slowing Chronic Kidney Disease Progression After Hospitalization for Heart Failure: A FIDELITY Subgroup Analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Finerenone, a nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, reduces risk of heart and kidney outcomes in people with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and type 2 diabetes (T2D). Heart failure is the leading cause of hospitalization in patients with CKD. Here we evaluated whether the reduction in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) decline (CKD progression) with finerenone persists after hospitalization for heart failure (HHF).
METHODS AND RESULTS: This post hoc analysis utilized the FIDELITY dataset pooled from the phase 3 FIDELIO-DKD (NCT02540993) and FIGARO-DKD (NCT02545049) trials, comprising adults with CKD and T2D on optimized renin-angiotensin system inhibitor treatment, randomized 1:1 to finerenone or placebo. Participants included experienced HHF between 4 months post randomization and study end. The key outcome was change in chronic eGFR slope (eGFR estimated from serum creatinine) before and after HHF. To avoid confounding from serum creatinine changes preceding and following HHF, eGFR values ±90 (primary analysis), ±120, and ±150 days from HHF were excluded. Baseline characteristics, medications, and mean hospital stay length were generally balanced between treatment groups. For the primary analysis, both the pre-HHF and post-HHF mean change in eGFR declined slower with finerenone versus placebo (between-group difference 2.68 mL/min/1.73 m2/year [95% confidence interval [CI], 0.87 to 4.49] pre-HHF and 0.96 mL/min/1.73 m2/year [95% CI, -0.99 to 2.91] post-HHF).
CONCLUSION: Treatment with finerenone is associated with clinically meaningful attenuation of CKD progression in people with CKD and T2D before HHF, and persists post-HHF, suggesting that maintaining finerenone after HHF may continue to confer benefits in attenuating CKD progression.
items.authors: Shafi Tariq, Anker Stefan D, Pitt Bertram, Ruilope Luis M, Rossing Peter, Brinker Meike, Rohwedder Katja, Scott Charlie
items.summary_ja: CKDと2型糖尿病（T2D）を有する患者において、非ステロイド性ミネラルコルチコイド受容体拮抗薬フィネレノンのeGFR低下速度の抑制（CKD進行の遅延）が、心不全による入院（HHF）後も持続するかを評価したFIDELITY（FIDELIO-DKDとFIGARO-DKDのプールデータ）のpost hoc解析。HHF前後のeGFRスロプの変化を主要アウトカムとし、HHF前後±90日（主要解析）、±120日、±150日のeGFR値を除外して解析を行った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンによるCKD進行の抑制はHHF前に臨床的に有意な効果を示し、HHF後も持続した。HHF後もフィネレノンを継続することでCKD進行の抑制効果が得られる可能性が示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: 心不全はCKD患者の入院の最も多い原因であり、HHF前後でCKD進行の速度が変化する可能性がある。本解析は、HHFという臨床的に重要なイベント後もフィネレノンの腎保護効果が持続することを示し、HHF後の治療継続の根拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 第III相RCT（FIDELIO-DKDおよびFIGARO-DKD）のプールデータ（FIDELITY）を用いたpost hocサブグループ解析
items.endpoints_ja: HHF前後の慢性eGFRスロプの変化（血清クレアチニンから推定したeGFR）

items.title: Does higher kidney risk justify more finerenone? Reappraising absolute benefit against the safety window of FINEARTS-HF.
items.abstract: Chronic kidney disease has long been viewed as a reason for caution when prescribing mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) in heart failure (HF), a doctrine rooted in the safety record of the steroidal agents: in TOPCAT, drug discontinuation for adverse events rose steeply as kidney function declined. The prespecified kidney-risk analysis of FINEARTS-HF, which reported consistent relative benefit of the non-steroidal MRA finerenone across KDIGO risk bands with a non-significant interaction on the primary endpoint, is widely read as a mandate to treat higher-risk patients more readily. We welcome this move away from reflexive under-treatment, but argue that a careful reading supports a more qualified conclusion than "worse kidneys, therefore more finerenone." Two features deserve emphasis. First, the reassuring safety signal was generated within the trial's enrolment window, which excluded patients with an eGFR below 25 mL/min/1.73 m2 or a serum potassium above 5.0 mmol/L; extending "no excess hyperkalaemia" to the very-low-eGFR patients who most concern clinicians is an extrapolation, not a demonstrated finding. Second, absolute benefit did not increase smoothly with rising kidney risk: modelled absolute reductions were not largest in the highest-risk stratum, and a non-significant interaction test does not establish that the treatment effect is identical across strata. Earlier, larger falls in albuminuria among higher-risk patients are encouraging but remain a candidate intermediate endpoint rather than proof of durable cardiorenal gains. We therefore propose a proportionate strategy: allow a higher renal-risk band to prompt consideration of finerenone in suitable patients, resist equating a uniform relative risk with uniformly maximal absolute benefit or unchanged safety at very low eGFR, and escalate potassium monitoring in parallel with renal risk, especially at or beyond the trial's boundaries. The strongest inference is that finerenone is effective and well tolerated in patients with moderately advanced CKD, normal potassium, and close follow-up; its least secure inference is that the highest-risk patients are ipso facto the safest or most deserving recipients. Future work should define optimal monitoring for patients whose eGFR drifts very low during treatment.
items.authors: Guo Song, Li Yu
items.summary_ja: FINEARTS-HFの事前指定された腎リスク解析について、非ステロイド性MRAフィネレノンのKDIGOリスク帯域を通じた相対的効果の一貫性を再検討した論評。安全性シグナルはeGFR 25 mL/min/1.73 m2未満または血清カリウム5.0 mmol/L超の患者を除外した入選基準内で得られたものであり、絶対的効果は腎リスクの上昇に伴って滑らかに増加しなかったことを指摘し、「腎機能が悪いほどフィネレノンを積極的に」という単純な解釈には留保が必要と主張する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンは中等度CKD・カリウム正常・近接フォローアップのもとで有効かつ良好な忍容性を示すが、最高リスク患者が最も安全かつ最も適応であるという推論は最も不確実である。
items.why_matters_ja: FINEARTS-HFの腎リスク解析が「腎リスクが高いほどフィネレノンを積極的に投与すべき」と広く解釈されている現状に対し、安全性の一般化が試験の入選基準を超えた外挿であること、絶対的効果の層別分布が均一ではないことを指摘し、臨床現場での過剰な一般化を是正する意義を持つ。
