items.title: Metabolic Effects of a GLP-1 Analog Combined with Aerobic Training in Ovariectomized Rats.
items.abstract: Menopause is associated with visceral obesity, low-grade chronic inflammation, and increased risk of dyslipidemia, insulin resistance, and type 2 diabetes. Although exercise (EXE) and GLP-1 receptor agonists, such as semaglutide (SEM), have demonstrated beneficial effects on metabolic regulation, their combined impact in menopause models has been less investigated. In this study, ovariectomized female Wistar rats were divided into four experimental groups: sedentary plus saline (SED + SAL), sedentary plus semaglutide (SED + SEM), exercise (EXE + SAL), and EXE + SEM. The aerobic exercise protocol consisted of treadmill running at moderate intensity for four weeks, during which the rats received either SEM or SAL weekly. At the end of the protocol, metabolic parameters were assessed in blood, liver, soleus and gastrocnemius muscles. Both SEM groups had lower body weight, weight gain, relative subcutaneous white adipose tissue (scWAT) mass, glucose, total proteins, and triglycerides in serum and liver, while LDL cholesterol, glycogen in liver and gastrocnemius, and AMPK and HSF1 expression in gastrocnemius increased. EXE decreased total and LDL cholesterol, liver triglycerides and HSF1 expression in both tissues, while glycogen in liver and gastrocnemius, liver HSF1 expression and relative mass were increased. The combination of SEM + EXE increased glycogen content in the gastrocnemius and AMPK expression in both gastrocnemius and liver. This combined treatment reduced HDL levels, hepatic triglycerides and scWAT relative weight. These results suggest that SEM and EXE exert complementary effects on glycemic and lipid metabolism, with partially distinct metabolic outcomes that may involve different underlying mechanisms.
items.authors: Selau Bruna, Bastos Leonardo Marensi, Normann Rafaella Sanfelice, Cubas Gustavo Kasper, Herrmann Rodrigo de Oliveira Corrêa da Cunha, Barros Lucas Dos Anjos de Oliveira de, de Amaral Marjoriane, Trapp Márcia
items.summary_ja: 卵巣摘出ラット（閉経モデル）を用い、GLP-1受容体作動薬セマグルチド（SEM）と有酸素運動（EXE）の併用による代謝への影響を4群（SED+SAL、SED+SEM、EXE+SAL、EXE+SEM）で比較検討した。中等強度のトレッドミル走行を4週間実施し、週1回SEMまたはSALを投与した。プロトコル終了時に血液、肝臓、腓腹筋、ヒラメ筋の代謝パラメータを評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SEMとEXEは血糖・脂質代謝に対して相補的な効果を示し、部分的に異なる代謝的アウトカムが異なる基盤メカニズムを介して生じる可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 閉経は内臓肥満、低度慢性炎症、脂質異常症・インスリン抵抗性・2型糖尿病のリスク上昇と関連するが、運動とGLP-1受容体作動薬の併用効果は閉経モデルにおいて十分に研究されていない。
items.study_type_ja: 動物実験（前臨床研究）：卵巣摘出ラットを用いた4群比較の介入試験
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、体重増加、皮下白色脂肪組織（scWAT）相対質量、血清および肝臓のグルコース・総タンパク質・トリグリセリド、LDLコレステロール、HDLコレステロール、肝臓および腓腹筋のグリコーゲン、腓腹筋および肝臓のAMPK発現、腓腹筋および肝臓のHSF1発現、肝臓相対質量

items.title: Postoperative outcomes after total knee arthroplasty in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients receiving semaglutide versus tirzepatide: a propensity score-matched national research network analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Semaglutide (GLP-1 receptor agonist) and tirzepatide (dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist) are increasingly prescribed to adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Whether short-term postoperative outcomes differ between these agents was unknown.
METHODS: This was a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX research network database. Adults with T2DM who underwent primary TKA between June 1, 2022, and December 31, 2024, and had an active prescription for semaglutide or tirzepatide within 90 days preoperatively were eligible. 1:1 propensity score matching was conducted on age, sex, race, body mass index, hemoglobin A1c, comorbidity burden, and concurrent diabetes medication use, yielding 415 matched pairs. Outcomes through 90 and 180 days included medical complications, surgical complications, and healthcare utilization. Odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated using logistic regression.
RESULTS: After matching (n = 830), there were no differences in 90-day medical complications (OR 1.122, 95% CI 0.736-1.710; P = 0.591) or 180-day surgical complications (OR 1.632, 95% CI 0.845-3.152; P = 0.141) between semaglutide and tirzepatide cohorts. Individual events, including myocardial infarction, stroke, pneumonia, sepsis, pulmonary embolism, deep vein thrombosis, acute kidney injury (OR 0.867, 95% CI 0.417-1.801; P = 0.701), urinary tract infection (OR 1.562, 95% CI 0.863-2.827; P = 0.138), surgical site infection (OR 1.726, 95% CI 0.782-3.810; P = 0.172), periprosthetic joint infection, wound dehiscence, mortality, and revision-were statistically similar (all P > 0.05). Emergency department visits and/or readmissions were comparable at 90 days (OR 0.775, 95% CI 0.570-1.052; P = 0.102) and 180 days (OR 0.887, 95% CI 0.672-1.170; P = 0.397). Several outcomes had low event counts in both groups, limiting precision.
CONCLUSION: In a large, propensity-matched national cohort of primary TKA, semaglutide and tirzepatide demonstrated similar short-term safety and utilization profiles. These findings support continued perioperative use of either agent in T2DM patients undergoing TKA.
items.authors: Wu Kevin A, Choudhury Ankit, Wu Joshua A, Shenoy Devika A, Song Junho, Mai Eric, Dhanjani Suraj, Shatkin Michael
items.summary_ja: TriNetX研究ネットワークデータベースを用いた後方視コホート研究。2022年6月1日から2024年12月31日の間に初回人工膝関節置換術（TKA）を受けた2型糖尿病（T2DM）成人患者で、術前90日以内にセマグルチドまたはtirzepatideの処方が有効であった対象を抽出した。年齢、性別、人種、BMI、HbA1c、合併症負荷、併用糖尿病薬使用を基準に1:1プロパティスコアマッチングを行い、415対（n=830）を解析した。90日および180日の医学的合併症、外科的合併症、医療資源利用を比較し、ロジスティック回帰でオッズ比（OR）と95%信頼区間（CI）を推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 初回TKAを受けたT2DM患者において、セマグルチドとtirzepatideの間で90日・180日の短期的安全性プロファイルおよび医療資源利用に有意な差は認められなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチド（GLP-1受容体作動薬）とtirzepatide（GIP/GLP-1二重作動薬）はTKAを受けるT2DM患者に増加して処方されているが、両薬剤間の術後短期アウトカムの差は不明であった。本結果は、TKAを受けるT2DM患者においてどちらの薬剤も術前・術後期に継続使用可能であることを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（プロパティスコアマッチング、全国研究ネットワークデータベース）
items.endpoints_ja: 90日医学的合併症、180日外科的合併症、個別イベント（心筋梗塞、脳卒中、肺炎、敗血症、肺塞栓症、深部静脈血栓症、急性腎障害、尿路感染症、手術部位感染、周囲関節感染、創離開、死亡、再手術）、90日および180日の救急外来受診および/または再入院

items.title: Improvement of small fiber neuropathy assessed by corneal confocal microscopy following semaglutide treatment: a case report and literature review.
items.abstract: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) is the most common chronic complication of type 2 diabetes (T2D) and a major predisposing factor for the development of diabetic foot, one of the most devastating diabetes-related conditions associated with substantial morbidity and mortality. To date, no pharmacological therapy has been shown capable of preventing, halting, or reversing neuropathic damage. We report the case of a 57-year-old man with T2D and obesity (BMI 35.2 kg/m²) who presented with symptoms and signs of DPN, including a neuropathy symptom score (NSS) of 3/9, a neuropathy disability score (NDS) of 3/10, and a vibration perception threshold (VPT) of 22 volts (V) bilaterally. In vivo corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) was performed to further evaluate small fiber involvement. Despite adequate glycemic control (HbA1c 6.6%), semaglutide was initiated to optimize metabolic status and promote weight loss. After 6 months of treatment, both BMI and HbA1c had improved, while NSS, NDS, and VPT remained unchanged. Repeat CCM demonstrated improvement across all corneal nerve parameters. This case suggests that semaglutide-associated metabolic improvement, or a direct semaglutide effect on small fiber integrity, may contribute to early regeneration of small nerve fibers in DPN. Further studies are urgently needed to determine whether semaglutide has a therapeutic role in the management of DPN.
items.authors: Anastasiou Ioanna A, Tentolouris Nikolaos, Rebelos Eleni
items.summary_ja: T2Dおよび肥満（BMI 35.2 kg/m²）を伴う57歳男性のDPN症例報告および文献レビュー。血糖管理は十分（HbA1c 6.6%）であったが、代謝状態の最適化と減量目的でセマグルチドを開始。6ヶ月後、BMIとHbA1cは改善したが、NSS・NDS・VPTは変化なし。再検査の角膜共焦点顕微鏡（CCM）では、すべての角膜神経パラメータで改善が認められた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチド治療に伴う代謝改善、またはセマグルチドの末梢神経線維への直接作用が、DPNにおける小神経線維の早期再生に寄与する可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: DPNはT2Dで最も一般的な慢性合併症であり、糖尿病足発症の主要な危険因子である。現在までに、神経障害を予防・停止・逆転できる薬物療法は示されていない。本症例はセマグルチドがDPN管理に治療的役割を果たす可能性を示唆している。
items.study_type_ja: 症例報告および文献レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: BMI、HbA1c、神経症状スコア（NSS）、神経障害スコア（NDS）、振動覚閾値（VPT）、角膜共焦点顕微鏡（CCM）による角膜神経パラメータ
items.endpoint_results_ja: ベースライン：BMI 35.2 kg/m²、HbA1c 6.6%、NSS 3/9、NDS 3/10、VPT 22 V（両側）。6ヶ月後：BMI改善（具体値記載なし）、HbA1c改善（具体値記載なし）、NSS変化なし、NDS変化なし、VPT変化なし、CCMではすべての角膜神経パラメータで改善（具体値記載なし）。

items.title: The SGLT2i Treatment Gap in UK Primary Care: A Cross-Sectional RWE Study of Prescribing in Clinical Practice.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) improve cardiovascular and renal outcomes in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), chronic kidney disease (CKD) and chronic heart failure (CHF). Despite clinical guideline recommendations, SGLT2i uptake in UK primary care remains suboptimal and information on utilisation is limited. This study aims to quantify and describe the UK primary care population with T2DM, CKD and/or CHF who are eligible for but not currently prescribed an SGLT2i.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted using routinely collected electronic health records from the Optimum Patient Care Research Database. Adults aged ≥ 18 years on 1 July 2024 were included. Descriptive analyses estimated disease prevalence (defined by morbidity-coded diagnosis), SGLT2i eligibility (defined using NICE clinical guidelines) and current SGLT2i treatment (defined as any SGLT2i prescription in the previous 2 months) by conditions and selected characteristics. Main results are based on diagnosed disease; in a separate CKD sensitivity analysis, indicative CKD (without a morbidity code) was defined using kidney function test results.
RESULTS: In the study population of 9.8 million adults, prevalence was 6.52% for T2DM, 4.95% for diagnosed CKD (6.07% including indicative CKD) and 1.40% for CHF. Among all SGLT2i-eligible individuals, 17.5% were currently prescribed an SGLT2i. Current SGLT2i treatment was lowest in CKD-only patients (3.8% treated among eligible) and highest in those meeting eligibility criteria for all three indications (32.9% treated). SGLT2i treatment was lower in women and older adults.
CONCLUSIONS: SGLT2i therapy is significantly underutilised in UK primary care, particularly for CKD. Equitable implementation of SGLT2i clinical guidelines is vital to improve cardio-renal-metabolic care.
items.authors: Stefanska Chelsea, Chung Ryan, Ramjaun Salman, Jin Danyao, Doherty Ciara, McCafferty Kieran, Seidu Samuel
items.summary_ja: 英国プライマリケアにおけるSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）の処方ギャップを定量化・記述することを目的とした横断的RWE研究。Optimum Patient Care Research Databaseの電子健康記録を用い、2024年7月1日時点で18歳以上の成人を対象に、T2DM・CKD・CHFの有病率、NICEガイドラインに基づくSGLT2i適応該当率、および現在のSGLT2i処方率を記述的に分析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 英国プライマリケアにおいてSGLT2iは著しく未活用されており、特にCKD単独患者では適応該当者のうち3.8%のみが処方されていた。3疾患すべてに該当する患者でも32.9%にとどまり、ガイドラインの公平な実施が課題である。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2iは心血管・腎予後改善のエビデンスがあり、ガイドラインで推奨されているにもかかわらず、実臨床での処方率が低いことを大規模RWEデータで定量的に示した。臨床開発・ヘルスケア政策の観点から、未処方の原因解明や介入戦略の設計に重要な基盤データとなる。
items.study_type_ja: 横断的RWE研究（電子健康記録を用いた記述的分析）
items.endpoints_ja: T2DM・CKD・CHFの有病率、SGLT2i適応該当率（NICEガイドライン準拠）、現在のSGLT2i処方率（過去2ヶ月間のSGLT2i処方あり）

items.title: Carbon Emission Impact of Semaglutide in People with Obesity in the UK Using a Disease Modelling Approach.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: We aimed to assess the carbon footprint and clinical outcomes of once-weekly semaglutide in people with overweight or obesity in the UK using a disease modelling approach.
METHODS: A per-patient carbon footprint analysis was conducted to estimate emissions related to obesity management with semaglutide 2.4 mg as an add on to diet and exercise versus diet and exercise alone. A Markov state-transition cohort model (Core Obesity Model) was used for the analysis. Data were sourced from STEP and SELECT trials across three populations: (1) body mass index [BMI] ≥ 30 or ≥ 27 with one or more obesity-related complications (BMI30+/BMI27+C), (2) BMI ≥ 27 with one or more complications, including type 2 diabetes mellitus (BMI27+C), and (3) BMI ≥ 27 with established cardiovascular disease (BMI27+CVD). Carbon emissions were estimated using resource-based and cost-based methods. Key outcomes included life-years, quality-adjusted life-years, and incremental carbon footprint effectiveness ratio.
RESULTS: In the BMI30+/BMI27+C and BMI27+C populations, semaglutide was dominant, yielding 0.30 and 0.25 additional life-years, 0.51 and 0.46 additional quality-adjusted life-years, while reducing lifetime carbon emissions by 1.8% (9850 vs 10,030 kg of CO2 equivalent [CO2e]) and 1.9% (9792 vs 9983 kg CO2e), respectively. Manufacturing emissions of semaglutide were offset by reductions in carbon emissions resulting from fewer obesity-related complications. In the BMI27+CVD population, semaglutide improved life-years by 0.56 and quality-adjusted life-years by 0.59, but emissions increased (14,700 vs 14,444 kg CO2e) because of longer survival and increased monitoring. Scenario and sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the results.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide offers both clinical and environmental benefits in obesity management, supporting the UK's net-zero emissions goals.
items.authors: Lund Niels, Lübker Christopher, Rasche Andreas, Taylor Matthew, Xu Weiwei, Taneja Loveleen, Shukla Suramya, Olivieri Anamaria-Vera
items.summary_ja: 英国における肥満症患者を対象に、週1回セマグルチド2.4 mg（食事・運動療法併用）と食事・運動療法単独の炭素フットプリントと臨床アウトカムを、Markov状態遷移コホートモデル（Core Obesity Model）を用いて評価したモデリング研究。STEP試験とSELECT試験のデータを3つの母集団（BMI30+/BMI27+C、BMI27+C、BMI27+CVD）に適用し、リソースベース法とコストベース法で炭素排出量を推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: BMI30+/BMI27+CおよびBMI27+C母集団ではセマグルチドが優位（dominant）であり、寿命・QALYの改善とともに生涯炭素排出量を1.8〜1.9%削減した。一方、BMI27+CVD母集団では生存延長とモニタリング増加により排出量が増加した。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満治療におけるセマグルチドの臨床的効果と環境的インパクトを同時に評価し、英国のネットゼロ排出目標との整合性を示した点で、臨床開発・薬物経済学・環境持続可能性の交差点において重要な知見を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: モデリング研究（Markov状態遷移コホートモデル）
items.endpoints_ja: 寿命（life-years）、QALY（quality-adjusted life-years）、生涯炭素排出量（kg CO2e）、増分炭素フットプリント効果比（incremental carbon footprint effectiveness ratio）
items.endpoint_results_ja: BMI30+/BMI27+C：寿命+0.30年、QALY+0.51、炭素排出量 9850 vs 10,030 kg CO2e（1.8%削減）。BMI27+C：寿命+0.25年、QALY+0.46、炭素排出量 9792 vs 9983 kg CO2e（1.9%削減）。BMI27+CVD：寿命+0.56年、QALY+0.59、炭素排出量 14,700 vs 14,444 kg CO2e（増加）。

items.title: Increased Energy Expenditure through Intermittent Cold Exposure Does Not Enhance Tirzepatide Induced Weight-loss in Obese Mice.
items.abstract: Obesity results from an imbalance between energy intake and energy expenditure. While pharmacological approaches such as tirzepatide, a dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, reduce food intake and body weight, enhancing energy expenditure via intermittent cold exposure-induced activation of thermogenesis may provide complementary benefits. Intermittent cold exposure increases energy expenditure and improves glucose homeostasis independent of weight loss. The objective of this study was to investigate the individual and combined effects of tirzepatide and intermittent cold exposure (ICE) on weight loss and glucose homeostasis. We hypothesized that combining ICE with tirzepatide would lead to greater weight loss and improvements in glucose homeostasis than tirzepatide alone. Male and female C57BL/6J mice were fed a high fat diet for 8 weeks and then treated with tirzepatide (10 nmol/kg) or vehicle and exposed, or not, to ICE (4°C, 1 h/day, 5 days/week) for 3 weeks. Body weight/composition, energy expenditure, food intake and glucose homeostasis were assessed. Tirzepatide reduced body weight, food intake, and adiposity in both sexes while ICE, acutely increased energy expenditure and improved glucose homeostasis independent of changes in body weight. There were no additive effects of combining tirzepatide and ICE. Our findings highlight that combining tirzepatide-mediated reduction in energy intake with ICE-induced activation of thermogenesis yields complementary, but not necessarily additive improvements in metabolic health.
items.journal: American journal of physiology. Regulatory, integrative and comparative physiology
items.authors: Bellucci Annalaura, Alfares Hadil, Gale Clara, Akcan Michael, Waters Ben, Eisner Katelyn, Baranowski Bradley J, Jeromson Stewart
items.summary_ja: 肥満マウス（C57BL/6J、高脂肪食8週間）において、tirzepatide（10 nmol/kg）と間欠的寒冷曝露（ICE：4°C、1時間/日、週5日、3週間）の単独および併用効果について体重・体組成、エネルギー消費、食物摂取量、グルコース恒常性に及ぼす影響を評価した。Tirzepatideは両性で体重・食物摂取量・脂肪量を減少させ、ICEは体重変化に依存せずエネルギー消費を急性増加させグルコース恒常性を改善した。両者の併用による相加効果は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Tirzepatideと間欠的寒冷曝露の併用は、tirzepatide単独投与に比べ体重減少の相加効果を示さず、両介入は代謝健康に対して補完的だが必ずしも相加的ではない改善をもたらす。
items.why_matters_ja: 薬物療法（GIP/GLP-1受容体作動薬）と生活習慣介入（寒冷曝露による熱産生促進）の併用が体重減少をさらに増強するかという臨床的に重要な問いに答えており、臨床試験デザインや患者への介入戦略の検討に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（マウスモデル、多群比較介入試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重/体組成、エネルギー消費、食物摂取量、グルコース恒常性
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値は記載されていない。定性的な結果として：tirzepatideは両性で体重・食物摂取量・脂肪量を減少、ICEは体重変化に依存せずエネルギー消費を急性増加させグルコース恒常性を改善、併用による相加効果は認められなかった。
